rows.translation: Rýchly pevný príklep tesne pri pražci
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Speed and aim matter more than force. Land on the fingertip, right behind the fret, and the string keeps singing.
rows.translation: Rýchlosť a presnosť sú dôležitejšie než sila. Dopadnite končekom prsta tesne pri pražci zo strany hlavy a struna bude znieť ďalej.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A pull-off drops to a lower note. With both fingers down, pick the higher note, then flick the top finger off sideways so it plucks the string as it leaves.
rows.translation: Odtrh prejde na nižší tón. Položte oba prsty, brnknite na vyšší tón a potom horný prst odtiahnite do strany tak, aby pri odchode brnkol na strunu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Fret 2 on string 3, then flick finger 2 off to sound open G.
rows.translation: Pražec 2 na strune 3, potom odtrhnite prst 2, aby zaznelo prázdne G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Fingers 1 and 3 on frets 5 and 7. Pick, then pull finger 3 off.
rows.translation: Prsty 1 a 3 na pražcoch 5 a 7. Brnknite, potom odtrhnite prst 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In a pull-off, the top finger…
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Flicks off sideways, plucking the string
rows.translation: Odtiahne sa do strany a brnkne na strunu
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Lifting straight up lets the note die. A small sideways flick plucks the lower note into life.
rows.translation: Pri zdvihnutí priamo nahor tón zanikne. Malý pohyb do strany rozozvučí nižší tón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: To slide, pick a note and keep pressing as you glide the same finger to a new fret. The pressure carries the sound; only the first note is picked.
rows.translation: Pri sklze brnknite na tón a za stáleho tlaku posuňte ten istý prst na nový pražec. Tlak udržuje zvuk; brnká sa iba na prvý tón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 7. Pick, then slide up to fret 9 without lifting.
rows.translation: Prst 3 na strune 3, pražci 7. Brnknite a bez zdvihnutia skĺznite na pražec 9.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: During a slide, what keeps the note sounding?
rows.translation: Čo pri sklze udržiava znenie tónu?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Ease off and the note dies. Keep the same pressure all the way to the new fret.
rows.translation: Keď tlak uvoľníte, tón zanikne. Až po nový pražec udržujte rovnaký tlak.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Now back: pick fret 9 and slide down to fret 7.
rows.translation: Teraz späť: brnknite na pražci 9 a skĺznite na pražec 7.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A bend pushes the string across the fret to raise its pitch. A whole-step bend, the size of two frets, from fret 7 must sound exactly like fret 9.
rows.translation: Pri vyťahovaní tlačíte strunu naprieč pražcom a zvyšujete jej tón. Celotónové vytiahnutie, veľké ako dva pražce, z pražca 7 musí znieť presne ako pražec 9.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 3, fret 9: this is your bend target. Let it ring and remember it.
rows.translation: Struna 3, pražec 9: cieľový tón vytiahnutia. Nechajte ho znieť a zapamätajte si ho.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Put finger 3 on fret 7 with fingers 1 and 2 behind it on the same string. Push all three toward the ceiling, turning your wrist as if turning a doorknob.
rows.translation: Prst 3 položte na pražec 7 a prsty 1 a 2 zaň na tú istú strunu. Všetkými tromi tlačte k stropu a otáčajte zápästím, akoby ste otáčali guľou na dverách.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Your bend from fret 7 sounds lower than fret 9. What now?
rows.translation: Vytiahnutie z pražca 7 znie nižšie než pražec 9. Čo teraz?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A bend that falls short sounds sour. Push until it matches the target you heard.
rows.translation: Nedotiahnutý tón znie falošne. Tlačte, kým sa nezhoduje s cieľovým tónom, ktorý ste počuli.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Target, then a short bend. Same note or different?
rows.translation: Cieľový tón, potom nedotiahnutý tón. Rovnaké alebo odlišné?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Vibrato is a small bend and release, repeated quickly on a held note. Keep it narrow and even so the note stays in tune.
rows.translation: Vibrato je drobné vytiahnutie a uvoľnenie struny, rýchlo opakované na držanom tóne. Udržujte ho úzke a rovnomerné, aby tón zostal naladený.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The same five notes repeat up the neck. Box 2 starts where box 1 ends: finger 1 at fret 7 on strings 5, 4 and 3, finger 2 at fret 8 on strings 6, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Tých istých päť tónov sa opakuje vyššie na krku. Box 2 začína tam, kde box 1 končí: prst 1 na pražci 7 strún 5, 4 a 3, prst 2 na pražci 8 strún 6, 2 a 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 6: frets 8 and 10. String 5: frets 7 and 10.
rows.translation: Struna 6: pražce 8 a 10. Struna 5: pražce 7 a 10.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The same five notes as box 1, A C D E G, in a new place on the neck.
rows.translation: Rovnakých päť tónov ako v boxe 1, A C D E G, na novom mieste na krku.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: To travel from box 1 to box 2, slide finger 3 from fret 7 to fret 9 on string 3. You arrive in box 2 with your hand already in place.
rows.translation: Z boxu 1 do boxu 2 prejdete sklzom prsta 3 z pražca 7 na pražec 9 na strune 3. V boxe 2 už bude vaša ruka na správnom mieste.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Saltwater Sunday is a Timbre Original: laid-back reggae in A minor, where Am7 and D7 trade bars. Both pentatonic boxes fit over them. Hammer, pull and slide, and land on a chord note as each bar begins. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Slaná nedeľa je autorská pieseň Timbre: pohodové reggae v A mol, kde sa po taktoch striedajú Am7 a D7. Hodia sa k nim oba pentatonické boxy. Hrajte príklepy, odtrhy aj sklzy a každý takt začnite akordovým tónom. Celá skladba je v časti Piesne, v kategórii Autorské piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Over D7, which of these box notes belongs to the chord?
rows.translation: Ktorý z týchto tónov boxu patrí do akordu D7?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D7 is D, F sharp, A and C. C, its seventh, sounds settled; E and G only pass through.
rows.translation: D7 tvoria D, Fis, A a C. Jeho septima C znie ustálene; E a G sú iba priechodné tóny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Your break over Am7 and D7
rows.translation: Vaša sólová časť nad Am7 a D7
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: No new ideas: hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, bend targets, vibrato and both boxes. Play each phrase cleanly, then make it sing.
rows.translation: Nič nové: príklepy, odtrhy, sklzy, cieľové tóny vyťahovania, vibrato a oba boxy. Každú frázu zahrajte čisto a potom ju rozospievajte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A whole-step bend from fret 7 should match…
rows.translation: Celotónové vytiahnutie z pražca 7 má znieť ako…
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Target, then a bend. Same note or different?
rows.translation: Cieľový tón, potom vytiahnutý tón. Rovnaké alebo odlišné?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Z boxu 1 do boxu 2 s citom
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: E and A shapes up the neck, major and minor, the closer shape, and a progression in A.
rows.translation: Hmaty E a A vyššie na krku, dur a mol, bližší hmat a akordový sled v A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Your F barre is an E shape with a barre at fret 1. Slide the whole thing up and the name follows the root on string 6: at fret 3 it's G, at fret 5 it's A.
rows.translation: Vaše F je hmat E s barré na pražci 1. Posuňte ho celý nahor a názov sa mení podľa základného tónu na strune 6: na pražci 3 je G, na pražci 5 je A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: An E-shape barre at fret 5. Which chord?
rows.translation: Barré s hmatom E na pražci 5. Ktorý akord?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 6 counts up from E: F at 1, G at 3, A at 5. The barre's fret names the chord.
rows.translation: Struna 6 stúpa od E: F na 1, G na 3, A na 5. Pražec barré určuje názov akordu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Lift finger 2 and let the barre cover string 3. That's the E minor shape, and it moves the same way: F sharp minor at fret 2, A minor at fret 5.
rows.translation: Zdvihnite prst 2 a nechajte barré pritlačiť strunu 3. To je hmat E mol a posúva sa rovnako: Fis mol na pražci 2, A mol na pražci 5.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Hmat A, základný tón na strune 5
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: B minor was an A minor shape with a barre. The major A shape moves too: barre strings 1 to 5, then lay finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2, two frets higher.
rows.translation: B mol bol hmat A mol s barré. Posúvať sa dá aj durový hmat A: barré cez struny 1 až 5, potom prst 3 naplocho cez struny 4, 3 a 2 o dva pražce vyššie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: An A-shape barre at fret 3. Which chord?
rows.translation: Barré s hmatom A na pražci 3. Ktorý akord?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3, D at 5.
rows.translation: Struna 5 stúpa od A: B na 2, C na 3, D na 5.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The minor A shape moves too
rows.translation: Posúva sa aj molový hmat A
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: For minor, use your B minor fingers: 2, 3 and 4 build the A minor pattern in front of the barre. At fret 3 that's C minor.
rows.translation: Pri mole použite prstoklad B mol: prsty 2, 3 a 4 vytvoria pred barré hmat A mol. Na pražci 3 je to C mol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Most chords can be an E shape, root on string 6, or an A shape, root on string 5. Pick whichever sits closer to where your hand already is.
rows.translation: Väčšinu akordov možno hrať hmatom E so základným tónom na strune 6 alebo hmatom A so základným tónom na strune 5. Vyberte ten bližší k aktuálnej polohe ruky.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: You're playing G at fret 3. Where's the closest C?
rows.translation: Hráte G na pražci 3. Kde je najbližšie C?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: C's root is on string 5, fret 3. Stay at fret 3 and switch to the A shape.
rows.translation: Základný tón C je na strune 5, pražci 3. Zostaňte na pražci 3 a prejdite na hmat A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Keep the barre, swap the shape
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: From G to C at fret 3, finger 1 stays on the barre. Only the fingers in front of it change. It's the smoothest barre change there is.
rows.translation: Pri zmene z G na C na pražci 3 zostáva prst 1 na barré. Menia sa iba prsty pred ním. Je to najplynulejšia zmena barré akordov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D as an A shape sits at which fret?
rows.translation: Na ktorom pražci je D hrané hmatom A?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 5: A open, B at 2, C at 3, D at 5.
rows.translation: Struna 5: prázdne A, B na 2, C na 3, D na 5.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: F sharp minor, D, A, E
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: F sharp minor, D, A and E all live in the key of A. Start with F sharp minor as a barre and the other three open.
rows.translation: Fis mol, D, A a E patria do tóniny A. Začnite s Fis mol ako barré a ostatnými tromi otvorenými akordmi.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: F sharp minor as an E-shape barre sits at…
rows.translation: Na ktorom pražci je Fis mol ako barré s hmatom E?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 6: F at fret 1, F sharp at fret 2.
rows.translation: Struna 6: F na pražci 1, Fis na pražci 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Play it up the neck: F sharp minor at fret 2, D as an A shape at fret 5, A as an E shape at fret 5, and E as an A shape at fret 7.
rows.translation: Zahrajte vyššie na krku: Fis mol na pražci 2, D hmatom A na pražci 5, A hmatom E na pražci 5 a E hmatom A na pražci 7.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Let the barre go soft for an instant as you move, then squeeze as you land. Gripping hard all the way tires your hand and slows the change.
rows.translation: Pri presune barré na okamih uvoľnite a pri dopade znova pritlačte. Neustály silný stisk unavuje ruku a spomaľuje zmenu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: When should your fretting hand squeeze?
rows.translation: Kedy má ruka na hmatníku pevne stláčať?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Squeeze to land, relax to move. Constant force wears out your hand in minutes.
rows.translation: Pri dosadnutí pritlačte, pri pohybe uvoľnite. Neustála sila unaví ruku za pár minút.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: On the last up strum before a change, lift the barre and keep strumming. The open strings sound for a moment, the rhythm never stops, and you land on time.
rows.translation: Pri poslednom brnknutí nahor pred zmenou zdvihnite barré a brnkajte ďalej. Prázdne struny na chvíľu zaznejú, rytmus sa nezastaví a nový akord zahráte načas.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Spray Paint Sunrise is a Timbre Original: indie pop in E on E, B, C sharp minor and A. B and C sharp minor are both A-shape barres, two frets apart, so one hand shape does most of the work. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Úsvit nasprejovaný farbou je autorská pieseň Timbre: indie pop v E na E, B, Cis mol a A. B aj Cis mol sú barré s hmatom A, vzdialené dva pražce, takže väčšinu práce zvládne jeden tvar ruky. Celá skladba je v časti Piesne, v kategórii Autorské piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: C sharp minor as an A minor shape barre sits at…
rows.translation: Na ktorom pražci je Cis mol ako barré s hmatom A mol?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 5 counts up from A: B at 2, C at 3, C sharp at 4.
rows.translation: Struna 5 stúpa od A: B na 2, C na 3, Cis na 4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: No new ideas: E and A shapes, major and minor, choosing the closer shape and smooth changes. Relax between chords and land on beat one.
rows.translation: Nič nové: durové aj molové hmaty E a A, výber bližšieho hmatu a plynulé zmeny. Medzi akordmi uvoľnite ruku a nový akord zahrajte na prvú dobu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: An E-shape barre at fret 3 is…
rows.translation: Barré s hmatom E na pražci 3 je…
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Root on string 5 means which shape?
rows.translation: Ktorý hmat má základný tón na strune 5?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Funk sixteenths and scratches, the reggae chop, country boom-chick and a syncopated pop strum.
rows.translation: Funkové šestnástiny a tlmené údery, reggae sekanie, country bum-čik a synkopovaný popový rytmus.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Sixteenth notes split each beat in four: one-e-and-a, two-e-and-a. Your strumming hand doubles its speed, down-up-down-up inside every beat.
rows.translation: Šestnástinové noty delia každú dobu na štyri: raz-e-a-da, dva-e-a-da. Brnkajúca ruka zdvojnásobí rýchlosť: nadol-nahor-nadol-nahor počas každej doby.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: How many sixteenth notes fill one beat?
rows.translation: Koľko šestnástinových nôt vyplní jednu dobu?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: One-e-and-a: four even slices of every beat.
rows.translation: Raz-e-a-da: štyri rovnaké časti každej doby.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Funk loves the ninth chord. Finger 2 on string 5, fret 7, finger 1 on string 4, fret 6, and finger 3 flat across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 7.
rows.translation: Funk miluje nónové akordy. Prst 2 na strune 5, pražci 7, prst 1 na strune 4, pražci 6 a prst 3 naplocho cez struny 3, 2 a 1 na pražci 7.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Keep your hand moving in sixteenths, but relax your fretting fingers so most strums are dead, scratchy clicks. Press down only for the hits.
rows.translation: Rukou sa pohybujte v šestnástinách, ale prsty na hmatníku uvoľnite, aby väčšina brnknutí znela ako suché tlmené cvaknutie. Pritlačte iba pri znejúcich úderoch.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Fretting fingers resting lightly on the strings
rows.translation: Prsty hmatníkovej ruky ľahko na strunách
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Touching without pressing stops the strings from ringing. The strum turns into a crisp, percussive click.
rows.translation: Dotyk bez pritlačenia zastaví znenie strún. Brnknutie sa zmení na jasné, perkusívne cvaknutie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Squeeze for each hit, then relax right away so it stays short. Slide the whole E9 shape down two frets and you have D9.
rows.translation: Pri každom údere pritlačte a hneď uvoľnite, aby zostal krátky. Posuňte celý hmat E9 o dva pražce nadol a získate D9.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Reggae guitar answers the drums with short, bright chords on beats two and four. Strum just the thin strings and cut each chord off right away.
rows.translation: Reggae gitara odpovedá bicím krátkymi, jasnými akordmi na druhú a štvrtú dobu. Brnkajte iba cez tenké struny a každý akord hneď utlmte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Use the top four strings only. This A minor is the top of your A minor barre at fret 5: finger 3 on string 4, fret 7, finger 1 barring the rest.
rows.translation: Používajte iba štyri najvyššie struny. Toto A mol je vrch vášho barré A mol na pražci 5: prst 3 na strune 4, pražci 7 a prst 1 tvorí barré na ostatných.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: How long should a reggae chop ring?
rows.translation: Ako dlho má reggae sekanie znieť?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Squeeze, strum, release. The chop is a short bark, and the space after it is the groove.
rows.translation: Pritlačte, brnknite, uvoľnite. Sekanie je krátke šteknutie a rytmus tvorí aj priestor po ňom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Now the top of your D barre: finger 3 flat across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 7, finger 1 on string 1 at fret 5.
rows.translation: Teraz vrch vášho barré D: prst 3 naplocho cez struny 4, 3 a 2 na pražci 7, prst 1 na strune 1 na pražci 5.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Country rhythm splits the bar: a single bass note on beats one and three, a quick strum of the thin strings on two and four. Boom, chick, boom, chick.
rows.translation: Country rytmus rozdelí takt: jeden basový tón na prvú a tretiu dobu, rýchle brnknutie cez tenké struny na druhú a štvrtú. Bum, čik, bum, čik.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In boom-chick, what happens on beats two and four?
rows.translation: Čo sa pri bum-čik deje na druhú a štvrtú dobu?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A short strum of the thin strings
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Move the second boom to another string: in G, string 6 then string 4. In C, string 5 then 4. In D, string 4 then open string 5.
rows.translation: Druhé bum presuňte na inú strunu: v G struna 6, potom struna 4. V C struna 5, potom 4. V D struna 4, potom prázdna struna 5.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Booms in G, C and D
rows.translation: Basové údery v G, C a D
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Syncopation puts the strum where you don't expect it. Down on one, up on the and of two, up on the and of three, then down-up on four.
rows.translation: Synkopa umiestni brnknutie tam, kde ho nečakáte. Nadol na prvú dobu, nahor na „a“ druhej, nahor na „a“ tretej a potom nadol-nahor na štvrtú.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In this pattern, what does your hand do on beat two?
rows.translation: Čo robí ruka na druhú dobu v tomto vzore?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The pendulum never stops. On two the hand swings down without touching, ready for the up strum.
rows.translation: Kyvadlo sa nikdy nezastaví. Na druhú dobu ruka ide nadol bez dotyku, pripravená na brnknutie nahor.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Pop players often change chords on the last up strum, the and of four, so the new chord arrives a hair early. It pushes the song forward.
rows.translation: Popoví gitaristi často menia akord pri poslednom brnknutí nahor, na „a“ štvrtej doby. Nový akord tak príde o chĺpok skôr a posúva pieseň dopredu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The pop strum on four chords
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Sparkler Season is a Timbre Original: a summer anthem in C on C, G, A minor and F. Give it the syncopated pop strum, and change a hair early, on the and of four. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Sezóna prskaviek je autorská pieseň Timbre: letná hymna v C na C, G, A mol a F. Zahrajte synkopovaný popový rytmus a akordy meňte o chĺpok skôr, na „a“ štvrtej doby. Celá skladba je v časti Piesne, v kategórii Autorské piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open E and D at fret 3 on string 2, twice, then G at fret 3 on string 1, and back down to D.
rows.translation: Prázdne E a D na pražci 3 struny 2 dvakrát, potom G na pražci 3 struny 1 a späť nadol na D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Why change chords on the and of four?
rows.translation: Prečo meniť akord na „a“ štvrtej doby?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: So the new chord rings on beat one
rows.translation: Aby nový akord znel na prvú dobu
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Moving on the last up strum gets your hand there a hair early, so the new chord is ready for beat one.
rows.translation: Presun pri poslednom brnknutí nahor dostane ruku na miesto o chĺpok skôr, takže nový akord je pripravený na prvú dobu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: No new ideas: funk sixteenths, the reggae chop, boom-chick and the syncopated pop strum. Keep the hand swinging and change only what it hits.
rows.translation: Nič nové: funkové šestnástiny, reggae sekanie, bum-čik a synkopovaný popový rytmus. Rukou stále pohybujte a meňte iba to, čo zasiahne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Reggae chops land on which beats?
rows.translation: Na ktoré doby pripadá reggae sekanie?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A capo, G and D shapes on capo 2, and Oh! Susanna arranged with a verse and a chorus.
rows.translation: Kapodaster, hmaty G a D s kapodastrom na 2 a Oh! Susanna so slohou aj refrénom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A capo clamps every string at one fret. On fret 2, each open string sounds two frets higher, and your open chord shapes all move up with it.
rows.translation: Kapodaster pritlačí každú strunu na jednom pražci. Na pražci 2 znie každá prázdna struna o dva pražce vyššie a všetky otvorené hmaty sa posunú s ňou.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Before the capo: pluck strings 1 and 2 open. That's E and B.
rows.translation: Pred kapodastrom: brnknite na prázdne struny 1 a 2. To sú E a B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Now clamp the capo just behind fret 2 and pluck them again: F sharp and C sharp.
rows.translation: Teraz upnite kapodaster tesne pri pražci 2 zo strany hlavy a brnknite znova: Fis a Cis.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. You play a G shape. Which chord sounds?
rows.translation: Kapodaster na pražci 2. Hráte hmat G. Ktorý akord znie?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Two frets up from G is A. The shape stays G; the sound moves up with the capo.
rows.translation: O dva pražce nad G je A. Hmat zostáva G, ale zvuk sa s kapodastrom posunie nahor.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: With a capo you still think G, C and D, the shapes you know. The diagrams here name the chord you actually hear, so a G shape on capo 2 reads A.
rows.translation: S kapodastrom stále myslíte na známe hmaty G, C a D. Diagramy tu však pomenúvajú skutočne znejúci akord, takže hmat G s kapodastrom na 2 je označený A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G and D shapes on capo 2
rows.translation: Hmaty G a D s kapodastrom na 2
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The G family, two frets up
rows.translation: Rodina G o dva pražce vyššie
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: On capo 2, G, C, D and E minor shapes sound as A, D, E and F sharp minor. Same fingers, new key: A major.
rows.translation: S kapodastrom na 2 znejú hmaty G, C, D a E mol ako A, D, E a Fis mol. Rovnaké prsty, nová tónina: A dur.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. A D shape sounds as…
rows.translation: Kapodaster na pražci 2. Hmat D znie ako…
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Two frets above D is E.
rows.translation: O dva pražce nad D je E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D shapes work the same way. On capo 2, D, G and A shapes sound as E, A and B: the key of E with easy open fingerings.
rows.translation: Hmaty D fungujú rovnako. S kapodastrom na 2 znejú hmaty D, G a A ako E, A a B: tónina E s ľahkými otvorenými hmatmi.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Most songs alternate two sections. The verse tells the story; the chorus repeats the hook. Stephen Foster's Oh! Susanna (1848) has both. Capo off: it's in G.
rows.translation: Väčšina piesní strieda dve časti. Sloha rozpráva príbeh, refrén opakuje hlavný motív. Oh! Susanna od Stephena Fostera (1848) má obe. Bez kapodastra: je v G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The pickup and first bar: open G, A at fret 2, then open B, D at fret 3 twice, and open E.
rows.translation: Predtakt a prvý takt: prázdne G, A na pražci 2, potom prázdne B, dvakrát D na pražci 3 a prázdne E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which section usually comes back with the same words?
rows.translation: Ktorá časť sa zvyčajne vracia s rovnakými slovami?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Verses change their words as the story moves on. The chorus returns unchanged, and that's what people sing along to.
rows.translation: Text slôh sa s vývojom príbehu mení. Refrén sa vracia nezmenený a ľudia ho spievajú spolu s piesňou.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Back the verse with G and D7, boom-chick style: bass on one, strum on two. Three bars of G, one of D7, two of G, then D7 and G.
rows.translation: Slohu sprevádzajte G a D7 v štýle bum-čik: bas na prvú dobu, akord na druhú. Tri takty G, jeden D7, dva G, potom D7 a G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Established external song title identifying the Stephen Foster work; candidate requires reviewer decision on established Slovak title, not generic instruction. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Complete credited personal name Stephen Foster and original year1848, with no translatable prose. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: The chorus opens on C, string 2, fret 1, then jumps to open E. Its chords are C, G and D7, and its second half matches the verse's ending.
rows.translation: Refrén sa začína na C, strune 2, pražci 1, a potom skočí na prázdne E. Jeho akordy sú C, G a D7 a druhá polovica sa zhoduje so záverom slohy.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The opening: C twice on string 2, fret 1, then open E three times.
rows.translation: Začiatok: dvakrát C na strune 2, pražci 1, potom trikrát prázdne E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Then down: D twice, open B, open G, and A at fret 2.
rows.translation: Potom nadol: dvakrát D, prázdne B, prázdne G a A na pražci 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The three E's go short, long, short. Where does the long one start?
rows.translation: Tri E znejú krátko, dlho, krátko. Kedy sa začína dlhý tón?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: It starts on the and and rings across the next beat. That push is syncopation, like your pop strum.
rows.translation: Začína sa na „a“ a znie cez nasledujúcu dobu. Tento posun je synkopa, ako vo vašom popovom rytme.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: An arrangement decides what you play, and when. Yours: a Travis-picked intro, the verse as melody, the chorus strummed boom-chick, then the chorus melody to finish.
rows.translation: Aranžmán určuje, čo a kedy hráte. Váš: úvod Travisovým vybrnkávaním, sloha ako melódia, refrén v rytme bum-čik a na záver melódia refrénu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Sets the key and tempo before the melody
rows.translation: Pred melódiou určí tóninu a tempo
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A few bars of chords tell everyone where home is and how fast to go.
rows.translation: Pár taktov akordov všetkým ukáže, kde je domov a aké bude tempo.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Finish with the chorus melody and let the last G ring. Ending on the tune everyone just heard feels complete.
rows.translation: Na záver zahrajte melódiu refrénu a nechajte posledné G znieť. Známa melódia, ktorú práve všetci počuli, pôsobí ako úplný záver.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Gravel Road Two-Step is a Timbre Original: dance-hall country in A, on A, D and E. Clamp the capo on fret 2 and play it with G, C and D shapes, the ones you know best. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Two-step na štrkovej ceste je autorská pieseň Timbre: tanečné country v A na A, D a E. Upnite kapodaster na pražec 2 a hrajte známymi hmatmi G, C a D. Celá skladba je v časti Piesne, v kategórii Autorské piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. Which shape sounds as E?
rows.translation: Kapodaster na pražci 2. Ktorý hmat znie ako E?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Two frets above D is E. On capo 2 the G shape gives A, and the C shape gives D.
rows.translation: O dva pražce nad D je E. S kapodastrom na 2 dáva hmat G akord A a hmat C akord D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Pick the chord's root on beats one and three, and strum on two and four, each with a quick up after it. Boom, chick-a, boom, chick-a: the dancers' steps.
rows.translation: Na prvú a tretiu dobu brnknite základný tón akordu, na druhú a štvrtú celý akord a hneď po ňom krátko nahor. Bum, čik-a, bum, čik-a: kroky tanečníkov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: No new ideas: the capo, G and D shapes, and your Oh! Susanna arrangement. Play it as if someone's listening. Maybe someone is.
rows.translation: Nič nové: kapodaster, hmaty G a D a váš aranžmán Oh! Susanna. Hrajte, akoby vás niekto počúval. Možno aj počúva.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Capo on fret 2. A C shape sounds as…
rows.translation: Kapodaster na pražci 2. Hmat C znie ako…
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Five open shapes become five places to play G, and chords that stay near your hand.
rows.translation: Päť otvorených hmatov tvorí päť polôh na hranie G a akordy, ktoré zostávajú blízko ruky.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Every major chord can borrow the shape of open C, A, G, E or D, moved up the neck. Climbing from any one, the shapes come in that order, C A G E D, and each locks onto the next.
rows.translation: Každý durový akord môže použiť hmat otvoreného C, A, G, E alebo D posunutý po krku. Pri stúpaní od ľubovoľného z nich idú hmaty v poradí C A G E D a každý nadväzuje na ďalší.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: C, A, G, E and D: the five open shapes that every major chord can borrow, anywhere on the neck.
rows.translation: C, A, G, E a D: päť otvorených hmatov, ktoré môže každý durový akord použiť kdekoľvek na krku.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Climb from open G and the next shape is the E shape: your G barre at fret 3. Its root on string 6 is the same G as in the open chord.
rows.translation: Od otvoreného G je ďalším vyšším hmatom E: vaše G s barré na pražci 3. Základný tón na strune 6 je rovnaké G ako v otvorenom akorde.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open D moved up five frets is G. Finger 1 holds string 4 at fret 5, where the nut used to be. Fingers 2, 4 and 3 rebuild the D triangle above it.
rows.translation: Otvorené D posunuté o päť pražcov vyššie je G. Prst 1 drží strunu 4 na pražci 5 namiesto pôvodného nultého pražca. Prsty 2, 4 a 3 nad ním vytvoria trojuholník D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The D shape, string by string
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Where is the D shape's root?
rows.translation: Kde je základný tón hmatu D?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open D's root is open string 4. Moved up, finger 1 holds it: G at fret 5. String 2, fret 8 is a G too.
rows.translation: Základný tón otvoreného D je prázdna struna 4. Po posunutí ho drží prst 1: G na pražci 5. Aj struna 2, pražec 8 znie ako G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The E shape at fret 3 and the D shape at fret 5 share one note: G on string 4, fret 5. Keep your eyes on it as you move between them.
rows.translation: Hmat E na pražci 3 a hmat D na pražci 5 majú spoločný tón: G na strune 4, pražci 5. Pri prechode medzi nimi ho sledujte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open C moved up seven frets is G. Finger 1 lies across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 7, finger 2 takes string 2 at fret 8, and fingers 3 and 4 stretch to strings 4 and 5.
rows.translation: Otvorené C posunuté o sedem pražcov vyššie je G. Prst 1 leží cez struny 3, 2 a 1 na pražci 7, prst 2 je na strune 2, pražci 8 a prsty 3 a 4 sa natiahnu na struny 4 a 5.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The C shape, string by string
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Like open C, the C shape's root is on…
rows.translation: Rovnako ako otvorené C má hmat C základný tón na…
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open C's root is string 5, fret 3. Here your little finger holds it: G at fret 10.
rows.translation: Základný tón otvoreného C je na strune 5, pražci 3. Tu ho drží malíček: G na pražci 10.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Slide the C shape down to fret 2 and it's D, with its root on string 5, fret 5. The name always follows the root.
rows.translation: Posuňte hmat C nadol na pražec 2 a vznikne D so základným tónom na strune 5, pražci 5. Názov vždy určuje základný tón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The A shape, and around again
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Barre strings 5 to 1 at fret 10 and lay finger 3 across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 12. It's your A-shape barre, and it's G again.
rows.translation: Vytvorte barré cez struny 5 až 1 na pražci 10 a prst 3 položte cez struny 4, 3 a 2 na pražci 12. Je to vaše barré s hmatom A a opäť znie G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Na pražci 12 sa cyklus začína znova
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Past the A shape, the G shape comes back at fret 12: open G, one octave higher. From there the five shapes repeat in the same order.
rows.translation: Po hmate A sa na pražci 12 vracia hmat G: otvorené G o oktávu vyššie. Odtiaľ sa päť hmatov opakuje v rovnakom poradí.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Going up the neck, which shape comes after A?
rows.translation: Ktorý hmat nasleduje po A pri stúpaní po krku?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The order loops: C, A, G, E, D, then C again. After A comes G.
rows.translation: Poradie sa opakuje: C, A, G, E, D, potom znova C. Po A nasleduje G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: With CAGED you rarely have to jump. Around fret 5, G is the D shape, C is the G shape and D is the A shape. Three chords, one spot.
rows.translation: S CAGED málokedy musíte skákať. Okolo pražca 5 hráte G hmatom D, C hmatom G a D hmatom A. Tri akordy na jednom mieste.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which shape plays C right beside the D-shape G?
rows.translation: Ktorým hmatom zahráte C hneď vedľa G hraného hmatom D?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: C's G shape uses frets 5 and 8, right where your hand already is.
rows.translation: C hrané hmatom G používa pražce 5 a 8, presne tam, kde už máte ruku.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The same idea works lower: G as the E shape at fret 3, C as the A shape at fret 3, and D as the C shape at fret 2.
rows.translation: Rovnaký nápad funguje nižšie: G hmatom E na pražci 3, C hmatom A na pražci 3 a D hmatom C na pražci 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Lantern Hill is a Timbre Original: a campfire sing-along on G, C and D. Play its chorus open, then near fret 5, then near fret 3, and the same song moves around the neck. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Lampášový vrch je autorská pieseň Timbre: spoločné spievanie pri ohni na G, C a D. Refrén zahrajte otvorenými akordmi, potom pri pražci 5 a pri pražci 3. Tá istá pieseň tak cestuje po krku. Celá skladba je v časti Piesne, v kategórii Autorské piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Near fret 5, which shape plays C?
rows.translation: Ktorým hmatom zahráte C pri pražci 5?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: C's G shape uses frets 5 and 8, right beside the D-shape G and the A-shape D.
rows.translation: C hrané hmatom G používa pražce 5 a 8, hneď vedľa G hraného hmatom D a D hraného hmatom A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: No new ideas: G in all five shapes, and G, C and D near fret 3 and fret 5. Name each shape as you land it.
rows.translation: Nič nové: G vo všetkých piatich hmatoch a G, C a D pri pražcoch 3 a 5. Pri každom hmáte vyslovte jeho názov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G with the D shape sits at…
rows.translation: Na ktorom pražci hráte G hmatom D?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Three-note chords on the top strings: major and minor, every inversion, and progressions that barely move.
rows.translation: Trojzvuky na najvyšších strunách: dur a mol, každý obrat a akordové sledy s minimálnym pohybom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A triad is the smallest full chord: a root, a third and a fifth. On strings 3, 2 and 1, triads ring clear and bright, and they work anywhere on the neck.
rows.translation: Trojzvuk je najmenší úplný akord: základný tón, tercia a kvinta. Na strunách 3, 2 a 1 znejú trojzvuky čisto a jasne a fungujú kdekoľvek na krku.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which notes make a C major triad?
rows.translation: Ktoré tóny tvoria trojzvuk C dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Root, third, fifth: from C, skip a letter to E, then skip another to G.
rows.translation: Základný tón, tercia, kvinta: od C preskočte písmeno na E a potom ďalšie na G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Move the lowest note to the top and you get an inversion. With E at the bottom, C sits at frets 9, 8 and 8. With G at the bottom, it's the top of your open C.
rows.translation: Presuňte najnižší tón navrch a získate obrat. S E naspodku leží C na pražcoch 9, 8 a 8. S G naspodku je to vrch vášho otvoreného C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Every major triad on these strings uses one of three shapes, one per inversion. Learn them on G and D and you can find any major chord.
rows.translation: Každý durový trojzvuk na týchto strunách používa jeden z troch hmatov, po jednom na obrat. Naučte sa ich na G a D a nájdete každý durový akord.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G at frets 4, 3 and 3 has the same shape as…
rows.translation: G na pražcoch 4, 3 a 3 má rovnaký hmat ako…
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Both put the third at the bottom: one fret up on string 3, the other two level. Same shape, five frets apart.
rows.translation: Oba majú terciu naspodku: na strune 3 o pražec vyššie, zvyšné dve rovnako. Rovnaký hmat, vzdialený päť pražcov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D at frets 7, 7 and 5 has the root-position shape of your C at fret 5. Lower down, frets 2, 3 and 2 are the top of your open D.
rows.translation: D na pražcoch 7, 7 a 5 má rovnaký základný tvar ako C na pražci 5. Nižšie sú pražce 2, 3 a 2 vrchom otvoreného D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A minor triad is a major triad with its third one fret lower. On these strings, A minor at frets 2, 1 and 0 is the top of your open A minor.
rows.translation: Molový trojzvuk je durový trojzvuk s terciou o pražec nižšie. Na týchto strunách tvorí A mol na pražcoch 2, 1 a 0 vrch otvoreného A mol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Barre fret 5 across strings 3, 2 and 1 and you have A minor with C at the bottom. One finger, three notes.
rows.translation: Vytvorte barré na pražci 5 cez struny 3, 2 a 1 a získate A mol s C naspodku. Jeden prst, tri tóny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: E minor at frets 4, 5 and 3 puts B at the bottom. It sits right beside A minor at fret 5, so the change is tiny.
rows.translation: E mol na pražcoch 4, 5 a 3 má naspodku B. Je hneď vedľa A mol na pražci 5, takže zmena je nepatrná.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Pick the inversion closest to your hand and a progression barely moves. G, E minor, C and D all live between frets 2 and 5.
rows.translation: Vyberte obrat najbližší k ruke a akordový sled sa takmer nepohne. G, E mol, C aj D ležia medzi pražcami 2 a 5.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: From G at frets 4, 3, 3 to E minor at 4, 5, 3, which notes stay?
rows.translation: Ktoré tóny zostávajú pri zmene z G na pražcoch 4, 3, 3 na E mol na 4, 5, 3?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: B on string 3 and G on string 1 stay put. Only string 2 moves, from D up to E.
rows.translation: B na strune 3 a G na strune 1 zostávajú na mieste. Mení sa iba struna 2, z D nahor na E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The same four chords sit higher too: G at frets 7, 8 and 7, E minor at 9, 8 and 7, C at 9, 8 and 8, and D at 7, 7 and 5.
rows.translation: Rovnaké štyri akordy nájdete aj vyššie: G na pražcoch 7, 8 a 7, E mol na 9, 8 a 7, C na 9, 8 a 8 a D na 7, 7 a 5.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Play a triad's notes one at a time and you have an arpeggio. Through a progression, the notes make a melody of their own.
rows.translation: Zahrajte tóny trojzvuku po jednom a vznikne arpeggio. V akordovom slede tóny vytvoria vlastnú melódiu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A chord played one note at a time
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The top notes here run G, G, G, F sharp: almost still while the chords change under them. A note that two chords share is a common tone, and it's why triads sound so smooth.
rows.translation: Najvyššie tóny tu idú G, G, G, Fis: takmer stoja, kým sa pod nimi menia akordy. Tón patriaci dvom akordom je spoločný tón; vďaka nemu znejú trojzvuky tak plynulo.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Did the top note go up or down?
rows.translation: Išiel najvyšší tón nahor alebo nadol?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Roller Rink is a Timbre Original: retro dance pop on G, E minor, C and D, your four triads between frets 2 and 5. Small shapes on the top strings sound bright and tight, like a second guitar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Korčuliarsky parket je autorská pieseň Timbre: retro tanečný pop na G, E mol, C a D, vašich štyroch trojzvukoch medzi pražcami 2 a 5. Malé hmaty na vysokých strunách znejú jasne a presne ako druhá gitara. Celá skladba je v časti Piesne, v kategórii Autorské piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Roller Rink's loop is the one, six, four and five of G. Which chord is the six?
rows.translation: Sled Korčuliarskeho parketu tvorí prvý, šiesty, štvrtý a piaty stupeň G. Ktorý akord je na šiestom?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Count up G major: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. The chord on 6 is minor: E minor.
rows.translation: Počítajte po G dur: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5, E 6. Akord na 6 je molový: E mol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: No new ideas: major and minor triads, their inversions, G, E minor, C and D in two places, and the arpeggios. Keep every move small.
rows.translation: Nič nové: durové a molové trojzvuky, ich obraty, G, E mol, C a D v dvoch polohách a arpeggiá. Každý pohyb udržujte malý.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A minor triad is a major triad with…
rows.translation: Molový trojzvuk je durový trojzvuk s…
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Major, minor and dominant sevenths, open and barred, the ii–V–I, and swing comping.
rows.translation: Veľké durové, malé molové a dominantné septakordy, otvorené aj s barré, ii–V–I a swingový sprievod.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A major seventh chord adds the note one fret below the root's octave. It turns a plain major chord soft and dreamy. Open Cmaj7 is C with finger 1 lifted.
rows.translation: Veľký durový septakord pridá tón o pražec pod oktávou základného tónu. Bežný durový akord zjemní a zasníva. Otvorené Cmaj7 je C so zdvihnutým prstom 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Cmaj7 is C plus which note?
rows.translation: Ktorý tón pridáva Cmaj7 k C?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The major seventh sits one fret below the root's octave: B, just under C.
rows.translation: Veľká septima je o pražec pod oktávou základného tónu: B tesne pod C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Play the mini F, but let finger 1 press string 2 only. Open string 1, E, is the major seventh of F.
rows.translation: Zahrajte malé F, ale prstom 1 stláčajte iba strunu 2. Prázdna struna 1, E, je veľká septima od F.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A minor seventh chord adds the note two frets below the root's octave. It sounds mellow, between dark and bright. Am7 is A minor with finger 3 lifted.
rows.translation: Malý molový septakord pridáva tón o dva pražce pod oktávou základného tónu. Znie mäkko, medzi temným a jasným. Am7 je A mol so zdvihnutým prstom 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Dm7: finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, and finger 1 flat across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1. Em7: just finger 2 on string 5, fret 2.
rows.translation: Dm7: prst 2 na strune 3, pražci 2 a prst 1 naplocho cez struny 2 a 1 na pražci 1. Em7: iba prst 2 na strune 5, pražci 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Am7 is A minor plus which note?
rows.translation: Ktorý tón pridáva Am7 k A mol?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The minor seventh sits two frets below the root's octave: G, two frets under A.
rows.translation: Malá septima je o dva pražce pod oktávou základného tónu: G dva pražce pod A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Sevenths with the root on string 5
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Finger 1 holds string 5 at fret 3 and lies across to string 1. Finger 3 takes string 4, finger 2 string 3 and finger 4 string 2.
rows.translation: Prst 1 drží strunu 5 na pražci 3 a leží naprieč až po strunu 1. Prst 3 je na strune 4, prst 2 na strune 3 a prst 4 na strune 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Dm7 is your A minor barre with the little finger lifted. D7 is the A-shape barre with fingers 3 and 4 on strings 4 and 2. Both are named after string 5.
rows.translation: Dm7 je vaše barré A mol so zdvihnutým malíčkom. D7 je barré s hmatom A a prstami 3 a 4 na strunách 4 a 2. Oba názvy určuje struna 5.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Dm7 at fret 5. Where is its root?
rows.translation: Dm7 na pražci 5. Kde má základný tón?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Like every A-shape chord, it's named after its note on string 5.
rows.translation: Ako každý akord s hmatom A sa aj tento nazýva podľa tónu na strune 5.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Jazz's favorite move: the chord on the second note of the key, then the fifth, then home. In C that's Dm7, G7 and Cmaj7.
rows.translation: Obľúbený džezový postup: akord na druhom stupni tóniny, potom na piatom a nakoniec domov. V C sú to Dm7, G7 a Cmaj7.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Play the E7 shape as a barre at fret 3: finger 1 across all six strings, finger 3 on string 5 and finger 2 on string 3. Its root is on string 6.
rows.translation: Zahrajte hmat E7 s barré na pražci 3: prst 1 cez všetkých šesť strún, prst 3 na strune 5 a prst 2 na strune 3. Základný tón je na strune 6.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In the key of C, which chord is the ii?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord je v tónine C na stupni ii?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Complete standardized chord symbol Em7, matching displayed pitch and chord notation; no untranslated prose. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Complete standardized chord symbol Dm7, matching displayed pitch and chord notation; no untranslated prose. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: Count up from C: C is one, D is two. The seventh chord built on D is D minor seven.
rows.translation: Počítajte od C: C je prvý stupeň, D druhý. Septakord postavený na D je malý molový septakord D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Jazz players often let each chord ring for just a moment. Squeeze as you strum, ease off right after, and the chords start to swing.
rows.translation: Džezoví hráči často nechajú akord znieť iba chvíľu. Pri brnknutí pritlačte, hneď potom uvoľnite a akordy sa rozhojdajú do swingu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Swing guitarists comp: short chords that answer the band. The Charleston rhythm hits beat one and the swung and of two, then leaves space.
rows.translation: Swingoví gitaristi sprevádzajú krátkymi akordmi, ktoré odpovedajú kapele. Charlestonový rytmus hrá na prvú dobu a swingové „a“ druhej, potom nechá priestor.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In G, the two, five, one is Am7, D7 and Gmaj7. Am7 is the E minor seven barre at fret 5; Gmaj7 skips string 5, with its root on string 6, fret 3.
rows.translation: V G tvorí druhý, piaty a prvý stupeň Am7, D7 a Gmaj7. Am7 je barré s hmatom E mol so septimou na pražci 5; Gmaj7 vynecháva strunu 5 a má základný tón na strune 6, pražci 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Late Checkout is a Timbre Original: lo-fi in C on Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 and Am7. That's a ii–V–I, plus the six chord to start it over. Comp it with your barred sevenths and the Charleston. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Neskorý odchod z hotela je autorská pieseň Timbre: lo-fi v C na Dm7, G7, Cmaj7 a Am7. Je to ii–V–I so šiestym stupňom navyše na nový začiatok. Sprevádzajte septakordmi s barré a charlestonovým rytmom. Celá skladba je v časti Piesne, v kategórii Autorské piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In Late Checkout, which chord is the V?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord je v Neskorom odchode z hotela na stupni V?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Complete standardized chord symbol Am7, matching displayed pitch and chord notation; no untranslated prose. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: Count up C major: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5. The seventh chord on G is G7.
rows.translation: Počítajte po C dur: C 1, D 2, E 3, F 4, G 5. Septakord na G je G7.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: No new ideas: major, minor and dominant sevenths, open and barred, and the ii–V–I in C and G. Keep the chords short and the swing steady.
rows.translation: Nič nové: veľké durové, malé molové a dominantné septakordy, otvorené aj s barré, a ii–V–I v C a G. Akordy hrajte krátko a swing rovnomerne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which seventh sits one fret below the root's octave?
rows.translation: Ktorá septima je o pražec pod oktávou základného tónu?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G major in two octaves at fret 2, scale degrees and chords, and the Dorian and Mixolydian modes.
rows.translation: G dur v dvoch oktávach pri pražci 2, stupne stupnice a akordy, dórsky a mixolýdický modus.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A half step is one fret, a whole step two. Every major scale climbs whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half. That pattern gives major its sound.
rows.translation: Poltón je jeden pražec, celý tón dva. Každá durová stupnica stúpa: celý, celý, pol, celý, celý, celý, pol. Tento vzor dáva duru jeho zvuk.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Put finger 1 at fret 2 and give each finger its own fret, up to fret 5. From G on string 6, fret 3, the scale climbs across strings 6, 5 and 4.
rows.translation: Prst 1 položte k pražcu 2 a každému prstu prideľte vlastný pražec až po pražec 5. Od G na strune 6, pražci 3 stupnica stúpa cez struny 6, 5 a 4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 6: frets 3 and 5, fingers 2 and 4. String 5: frets 2 and 3, fingers 1 and 2.
rows.translation: Struna 6: pražce 3 a 5, prsty 2 a 4. Struna 5: pražce 2 a 3, prsty 1 a 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 5, fret 5, then string 4: frets 2, 4 and 5. Home on G.
rows.translation: Struna 5, pražec 5, potom struna 4: pražce 2, 4 a 5. Domov na G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Where do the half steps fall in a major scale?
rows.translation: Medzi ktorými tónmi sú poltóny v durovej stupnici?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Medzi tónmi 3 a 4 a tiež 7 a 8
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Whole, whole, half: the first half step is from 3 to 4. Whole, whole, whole, half: the second is from 7 to 8.
rows.translation: Celý, celý, pol: prvý poltón je od 3 do 4. Celý, celý, celý, pol: druhý je od 7 do 8.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The same position carries on: A, B and C on string 3, D and E on string 2, F sharp and G on string 1. Your hand never moves.
rows.translation: Pokračujete v rovnakej polohe: A, B a C na strune 3, D a E na strune 2, Fis a G na strune 1. Ruka sa vôbec neposúva.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 3: frets 2, 4, 5. String 2: frets 3, 5. String 1: frets 2, 3.
rows.translation: Struna 3: pražce 2, 4, 5. Struna 2: pražce 3, 5. Struna 1: pražce 2, 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In this position, which finger plays fret 5?
rows.translation: Ktorý prst hrá v tejto polohe na pražci 5?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Finger 1 sits at fret 2, so fret 5 belongs to finger 4, your little finger.
rows.translation: Prst 1 je na pražci 2, preto pražec 5 patrí prstu 4, malíčku.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Dve oktávy od G po G
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A carol built on the scale
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Joy to the World, arranged by Lowell Mason in 1839, opens with the G major scale straight down from the top. You know every note already.
rows.translation: Radosť svetu, ktorú v roku 1839 upravil Lowell Mason, sa začína stupnicou G dur priamo nadol od najvyššieho tónu. Všetky tóny už poznáte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Joy to the World, in position
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Number the scale from G: G is 1, A is 2, and so on up to F sharp, 7. Musicians use these numbers to talk about melodies and chords in any key.
rows.translation: Očíslujte stupnicu od G: G je 1, A je 2 a tak ďalej po Fis, 7. Hudobníci takto hovoria o melódiách a akordoch v ľubovoľnej tónine.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In G major, which note is 5?
rows.translation: Ktorý tón je v G dur na stupni 5?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Count up from G: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5.
rows.translation: Počítajte od G: G 1, A 2, B 3, C 4, D 5.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Stack every other scale note on each degree and you get the key's chords. Chords on 1, 4 and 5 are major; on 2, 3 and 6 they're minor. In G: G, C and D, then A minor, B minor and E minor.
rows.translation: Na každom stupni navrstvite každý druhý tón stupnice a získate akordy tóniny. Na 1, 4 a 5 sú durové, na 2, 3 a 6 molové. V G: G, C a D, potom A mol, B mol a E mol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In G major, which chord is built on 6?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord v G dur stojí na stupni 6?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The sixth note is E, and chords on 2, 3 and 6 are minor. Stack E, G and B: E minor.
rows.translation: Šiesty tón je E a akordy na 2, 3 a 6 sú molové. Navrstvite E, G a B: E mol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Play G major's notes but treat A as home, and the scale turns minor. This sound is A Dorian, a mode of G major: same position, new starting note.
rows.translation: Hrajte tóny G dur, ale za domov považujte A, a stupnica získa molový charakter. To je dórsky modus od A, modus G dur: rovnaká poloha, nový východiskový tón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Start on A, string 6, fret 5, with finger 4, and climb the same frets to A on string 3.
rows.translation: Začnite na A, strune 6, pražci 5 prstom 4 a rovnakými pražcami stúpajte k A na strune 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which note makes A Dorian brighter than plain A minor?
rows.translation: Ktorý tón robí dórsky modus od A jasnejším než prirodzené A mol?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Plain A minor has F. Dorian keeps G major's F sharp: a bright spot in a minor scale.
rows.translation: Prirodzené A mol má F. Dórsky modus si ponechá Fis z G dur: jasný bod v molovej stupnici.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Now treat D as home. G major's notes from D to D make D Mixolydian: a major scale with its seventh one fret lower. It's all over folk, rock and fiddle tunes.
rows.translation: Teraz považujte za domov D. Tóny G dur od D po D tvoria mixolýdický modus od D: durovú stupnicu so septimou o pražec nižšie. Znie vo folku, rocku aj husľových ľudových melódiách.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: From D on string 5, fret 5, up the same position to D on string 2, fret 3.
rows.translation: Od D na strune 5, pražci 5 v rovnakej polohe nahor k D na strune 2, pražci 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D major has C sharp. D Mixolydian has…
rows.translation: D dur má Cis. Mixolýdický modus od D má…
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Mixolydian lowers the seventh by one fret, so G major's C becomes its flavor note.
rows.translation: Mixolýdický modus znižuje septimu o pražec, preto mu C z G dur dodáva charakteristickú farbu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Any note of the major scale can be home. From G it's major, from A Dorian, from D Mixolydian, from E plain minor. Same frets, different moods.
rows.translation: Domovom môže byť každý tón durovej stupnice. Od G je to dur, od A dórsky, od D mixolýdický modus, od E prirodzený mol. Rovnaké pražce, rôzne nálady.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Market Day is a Timbre Original: sunny pop in G with a highlife bounce, the bright guitar music of West Africa. Its hook uses only G major's notes, so it sits inside your second-position scale. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Trhový deň je autorská pieseň Timbre: slnečný pop v G s pulzom highlife, jasnej gitarovej hudby západnej Afriky. Hlavný motív používa iba tóny G dur, preto sa zmestí do stupnice v druhej polohe. Celá skladba je v časti Piesne, v kategórii Autorské piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Market Day's chords are G, B minor, C and D. Which scale degrees are they on?
rows.translation: Akordy Trhového dňa sú G, B mol, C a D. Na ktorých stupňoch stoja?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G is 1, B is 3, C is 4 and D is 5. The chord on 3 is minor in every major key: B minor.
rows.translation: G je 1, B je 3, C je 4 a D je 5. Akord na 3 je v každej durovej tónine molový: B mol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D at fret 3 on string 2, B at fret 4 on string 3, D again, E at fret 5 with finger 4, then D and B.
rows.translation: D na pražci 3 struny 2, B na pražci 4 struny 3, znova D, E na pražci 5 prstom 4, potom D a B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: No new ideas: G major in two octaves, the scale in thirds, A Dorian and D Mixolydian. Keep one finger per fret.
rows.translation: Nič nové: G dur v dvoch oktávach, stupnica v terciách, dórsky modus od A a mixolýdický od D. Každému pražcu nech patrí jeden prst.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half spells…
rows.translation: Celý, celý, pol, celý, celý, celý, pol tvorí…
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which mode starts on the second note of G major?
rows.translation: Ktorý modus začína na druhom tóne G dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The major pentatonic, country hammer-ons and slides, trills, phrasing, and sweet and sour over the blues.
rows.translation: Durová pentatonika, country príklepy a sklzy, trilky, frázovanie a sladké aj drsné farby nad blues.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Move your minor pentatonic box from fret 5 down to fret 2 and treat A as home: it turns sweet and major. That's A major pentatonic: A, B, C sharp, E and F sharp.
rows.translation: Posuňte box molovej pentatoniky z pražca 5 na pražec 2 a za domov považujte A: získa sladký durový zvuk. To je pentatonika A dur: A, B, Cis, E a Fis.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: From A on string 6, fret 5, then frets 2 and 4 on strings 5 and 4, and A at fret 2 on string 3.
rows.translation: Od A na strune 6, pražci 5, potom pražce 2 a 4 na strunách 5 a 4 a A na pražci 2 struny 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which notes are in A major pentatonic?
rows.translation: Ktoré tóny obsahuje pentatonika A dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: The full answer is a pitch-letter sequence A, C, D, E, G; preserving every note and order is essential to the pentatonic quiz. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: The full answer is a pitch-letter sequence A, B, C, D, E; preserving every note and order is essential to the pentatonic quiz. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: A, B, C sharp, E, F sharp
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Five notes of the A major scale, its two half steps left out. The minor box at fret 5 holds A, C, D, E and G.
rows.translation: Päť tónov stupnice A dur bez jej dvoch poltónových krokov. Molový box na pražci 5 obsahuje A, C, D, E a G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A major pentatonic, up and down
rows.translation: Pentatonika A dur nahor a nadol
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: This box at fret 2 is also F sharp minor pentatonic, from its F sharp. The note you treat as home decides which one you're playing.
rows.translation: Tento box na pražci 2 je od svojho Fis aj pentatonikou Fis mol. O tom, ktorú hráte, rozhoduje tón, ktorý považujete za domov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Country players love hammer-ons inside this box: E to F sharp on string 4, A to B on string 3. Pick the first note, then hammer the second.
rows.translation: Country hráči obľubujú príklepy v tomto boxe: z E na Fis na strune 4, z A na B na strune 3. Na prvý tón brnknite, druhý zahrajte príklepom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 4: pick fret 2, then hammer finger 3 onto fret 4.
rows.translation: Struna 4: brnknite na pražci 2, potom priklepnite prst 3 na pražec 4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Now slide finger 3 on string 3 from fret 4 to fret 6, B up to C sharp, then glide back into the box.
rows.translation: Teraz posuňte prst 3 na strune 3 z pražca 4 na pražec 6, z B nahor na Cis, a potom späť do boxu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Finger 3 on string 3, fret 4. Pick, then slide to fret 6 without lifting.
rows.translation: Prst 3 na strune 3, pražci 4. Brnknite a bez zdvihnutia skĺznite na pražec 6.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Trilky a nájazdy na tóny sklzom
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A trill flutters between two notes: one pick, then hammer-on, pull-off, over and over. Keep it even before you make it fast.
rows.translation: Trilok kmitá medzi dvoma tónmi: jedno brnknutie, potom príklep a odtrh stále dookola. Najprv ho hrajte rovnomerne, až potom rýchlo.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 3: frets 2 and 4. Pick once, then hammer and pull with finger 3.
rows.translation: Struna 3: pražce 2 a 4. Raz brnknite a potom prstom 3 striedajte príklep a odtrh.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Start one fret below the note you want and slide up into it as you pick. The target is what counts: land it right on the beat.
rows.translation: Začnite o pražec pod požadovaným tónom a pri brnknutí doň skĺznite nahor. Rozhoduje cieľový tón: trafte ho presne na dobu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: When you slide into a note, which one lands on the beat?
rows.translation: Ktorý tón pri nájazde sklzom zaznie presne na dobu?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The slide starts just before the beat, so the note you're aiming for arrives right on it.
rows.translation: Sklz začína tesne pred dobou, aby cieľový tón zaznel presne na ňu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Over a blues in A, both boxes work. Major pentatonic at fret 2 sounds sweet; minor at fret 5 sounds tough. Good players move between them.
rows.translation: Nad blues v A fungujú oba boxy. Durová pentatonika na pražci 2 znie sladko, molová na pražci 5 drsne. Dobrí hráči medzi nimi prechádzajú.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which box sounds sweeter over A7?
rows.translation: Ktorý box znie nad A7 sladšie?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The major pentatonic holds C sharp, the third of A7. The minor box's C rubs against it, and that rub is the blues.
rows.translation: Durová pentatonika obsahuje Cis, terciu A7. C z molového boxu voči nemu vytvára napätie a to tvorí blues.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Ask a tough question at fret 5, then answer it sweetly at fret 2. Shift your hand on the long note, and land both phrases on A.
rows.translation: Položte drsnú otázku na pražci 5 a sladko odpovedzte na pražci 2. Ruku presuňte počas dlhého tónu a obe frázy ukončite na A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Great solos breathe. Play a short phrase, rest about as long as it lasted, then answer. The silence makes the next notes count.
rows.translation: Skvelé sóla dýchajú. Zahrajte krátku frázu, odpočívajte približne rovnako dlho a potom odpovedzte. Vďaka tichu majú ďalšie tóny váhu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: After a two-beat phrase, how long might you rest?
rows.translation: Ako dlho môžete odpočívať po dvojdobovej fráze?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Play a phrase twice the same way, then change only its ending. Listeners hear the repeat and lean in for the twist.
rows.translation: Frázu zahrajte dvakrát rovnako a potom zmeňte iba záver. Poslucháči spoznajú opakovanie a čakajú na prekvapenie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Hold each long note and rock it with a small, even push and release. Keep it narrow: the pitch should waver, never wander off.
rows.translation: Každý dlhý tón podržte a rozhojdajte malým rovnomerným vytiahnutím a uvoľnením. Rozsah nech je úzky: výška tónu sa má chvieť, nie blúdiť mimo.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Slow Motion Strobe is a Timbre Original: synth-pop in A on F sharp minor, D, A and E. Your box at fret 2 fits the whole loop: A major pentatonic, which is F sharp minor pentatonic too. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Spomalený stroboskop je autorská pieseň Timbre: synth-pop v A na Fis mol, D, A a E. Váš box na pražci 2 sedí na celý sled: je to pentatonika A dur aj Fis mol. Celá skladba je v časti Piesne, v kategórii Autorské piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Listen to the first chord. Major or minor?
rows.translation: Vypočujte si prvý akord. Je durový alebo molový?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Over F sharp minor and D
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which box notes belong to the E chord?
rows.translation: Ktoré tóny boxu patria do akordu E?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: E is E, G sharp and B. The box holds E and B but no G sharp, so lean on those two over E.
rows.translation: E tvoria E, Gis a B. Box obsahuje E a B, ale nie Gis, preto sa nad E oprite o tieto dva tóny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: No new ideas: the major pentatonic, hammer-ons, slides, trills and both boxes over the blues. Leave space, and finish on A.
rows.translation: Nič nové: durová pentatonika, príklepy, sklzy, trilky a oba boxy nad blues. Nechajte priestor a skončite na A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Slide the minor box from fret 5 to fret 2 and it plays…
rows.translation: Posuňte molový box z pražca 5 na pražec 2 a zahrá…
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Verse, chorus and AABA, intros and tags, texture and fills, and your own arrangement of Down by the Riverside.
rows.translation: Sloha, refrén a AABA, úvody a opakované závery, spôsob sprievodu, výplne a vlastný aranžmán Down by the Riverside.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Most songs are built from a few sections: verses that tell the story, a chorus that repeats the hook, and sometimes a bridge for contrast. Knowing the plan keeps you from getting lost.
rows.translation: Väčšinu piesní tvorí niekoľko častí: slohy rozprávajú príbeh, refrén opakuje hlavný motív a mostík niekedy prináša kontrast. Keď poznáte plán, nestratíte sa.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: What does a chorus usually carry?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The chorus returns with the same words and tune. It's the part people remember and sing along to.
rows.translation: Refrén sa vracia s rovnakými slovami a melódiou. Je to časť, ktorú si ľudia zapamätajú a spievajú spolu s piesňou.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Many older songs use AABA: a tune, the same tune again, a contrasting bridge, then the tune once more. Each section often runs eight bars; here they run four.
rows.translation: Mnohé staršie piesne používajú AABA: melódia, znova tá istá melódia, kontrastný mostík a ešte raz melódia. Každá časť má často osem taktov; tu má štyri.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In AABA form, which section is the bridge?
rows.translation: Ktorá časť formy AABA je mostík?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The easiest intro is the song's last line, played before the first verse. It sets the key, the tempo and the mood, and the singer knows exactly where to come in.
rows.translation: Najjednoduchší úvod tvorí posledný riadok piesne zahraný pred prvou slohou. Určí tóninu, tempo aj náladu a spevák presne vie, kde nastúpiť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: An intro from the last line
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Why start with the song's last line?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: It sets the key and tempo
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: To end, repeat the last line, often twice more, and let the final chord ring. A tag tells everyone the song is closing.
rows.translation: Na záver zopakujte posledný riadok, často ešte dvakrát, a nechajte posledný akord znieť. Opakovaný záver každému oznámi, že sa pieseň končí.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Arrangers lift a chorus by changing what the guitar does. Fingerpick the verse softly, then strum the chorus, and the same chords suddenly sound bigger.
rows.translation: Aranžéri zvýraznia refrén zmenou hry gitary. Slohu jemne vybrnkávajte prstami, v refréne brnkajte celé akordy a rovnaké akordy zrazu znejú mohutnejšie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Verse: Travis on G and D7
rows.translation: Sloha: Travis na G a D7
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Each section can add a little: a picked verse, a strummed chorus, then triads up the neck for the last chorus. Save your biggest sound for the end.
rows.translation: Každá časť môže niečo pridať: vybrnkávaná sloha, refrén hraný celými akordmi a potom trojzvuky vyššie na krku v poslednom refréne. Najväčší zvuk si nechajte na koniec.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: When the melody holds a long note, a solo guitarist fills the space: a bass note or two from the chord, then back to the tune in time.
rows.translation: Keď melódia drží dlhý tón, sólový gitarista vyplní priestor: jeden či dva basové tóny z akordu a potom včas späť k melódii.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: On top of every melody note
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Fill with notes of the chord under the long note. Over G: G, B and D. Over D7: D, F sharp, A and C. They can't clash with the band.
rows.translation: Pod dlhým tónom vyplňte priestor tónmi akordu. Nad G: G, B a D. Nad D7: D, Fis, A a C. S kapelou tak nebudú neladiť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Down by the Riverside: your arrangement
rows.translation: Down by the Riverside: váš aranžmán
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Down by the Riverside, a spiritual first printed in 1918, gets the full treatment: a Travis-picked intro, two verses and choruses, a pentatonic solo, and a tag.
rows.translation: Down by the Riverside, spirituál prvýkrát vydaný v roku 1918, dostane úplný aranžmán: úvod Travisovým vybrnkávaním, dve slohy a refrény, pentatonické sólo a opakovaný záver.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Intro: Travis on G and D7
rows.translation: Úvod: Travis na G a D7
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A solo in G major pentatonic
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The solo uses G major pentatonic in open position: G, A, B, D and E. It follows the verse's chords and ends a beat early, so the singer can come back in.
rows.translation: Sólo používa pentatoniku G dur v otvorenej polohe: G, A, B, D a E. Sleduje akordy slohy a končí o dobu skôr, aby sa spevák mohol vrátiť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which parts of this arrangement have no words?
rows.translation: Ktoré časti tohto aranžmánu nemajú slová?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Jukebox Moon is a Timbre Original: a fifties slow dance in AABA form, a verse, the verse again, a bridge on F, then the verse once more. Strum every beat, with a quick swung up into each new bar. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
rows.translation: Jukeboxový mesiac je autorská pieseň Timbre: pomalý tanec päťdesiatych rokov vo forme AABA: sloha, znova sloha, mostík na F a ešte raz sloha. Brnkajte na každú dobu a do nového taktu vstúpte krátkym swingovým úderom nahor. Celá skladba je v časti Piesne, v kategórii Autorské piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In Jukebox Moon, which section is the B?
rows.translation: Ktorá časť Jukeboxového mesiaca je B?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The verses share one tune: A, A. The bridge brings new chords and a new tune, B, then the verse returns.
rows.translation: Slohy majú rovnakú melódiu: A, A. Mostík prináša nové akordy a melódiu, B, potom sa sloha vráti.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Váš aranžmán od začiatku do konca
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: No new ideas: form, intros, tags, texture, fills and your Down by the Riverside. Play it straight through, like a set.
rows.translation: Nič nové: forma, úvody, opakované závery, spôsob sprievodu, výplne a vaše Down by the Riverside. Zahrajte všetko bez prerušenia ako koncertný set.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In AABA, how many times does the A tune come?
rows.translation: Koľkokrát sa vo forme AABA objaví melódia A?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Whole instrument name Ukulele is also the Slovak name, without untranslated descriptive prose. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: From G C E A to new keys, fingerpicking and a stage set
rows.translation: Od G C E A po nové tóniny, hru prstami a koncertný set
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Hold it, meet G C E A, play your first notes, your first chord and a song.
rows.translation: Uchopte ho, spoznajte G C E A a zahrajte prvé tóny, prvý akord aj pieseň.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Rest the body against your chest with the neck pointing left. The string nearest the floor is string 1. It plays the highest open note.
rows.translation: Telo oprite o hruď a krk nasmerujte doľava. Struna najbližšia k podlahe je struna 1. Hrá najvyšší prázdny tón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Strings count up from the floor side: 1, 2, 3, 4.
rows.translation: Struny sa počítajú od strany pri podlahe: 1, 2, 3, 4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Pluck string 1 with your thumb and let it ring.
rows.translation: Brnknite palcom na strunu 1 a nechajte ju znieť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Now string 2, the next one up.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G C E A, the open strings
rows.translation: G C E A, prázdne struny
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Entire open-string pitch sequence G C E A; letter order is essential to ukulele tuning. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: From string 4 down to string 1, the open strings are G, C, E, A. Try: Good Cooks Eat Apples.
rows.translation: Od struny 4 po strunu 1 znejú prázdne struny G, C, E, A. Pomôcka: Gorila Cíti Egrešovú Arómu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Play strings 4 and 3, one at a time.
rows.translation: Zahrajte na strunách 4 a 3, vždy po jednej.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: On most instruments the strings get lower as you go up. On ukulele, string 4 (G) is higher than string 3 (C). This is called re-entrant tuning.
rows.translation: Na väčšine nástrojov znejú struny nižšie, keď postupujete smerom nahor. Na ukulele je struna 4 (G) vyššia než struna 3 (C). Toto ladenie sa nazýva reentrantné.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The high G keeps every chord close together and bright. It is the sweet, ringing sound people know as ukulele.
rows.translation: Vysoké G drží tóny akordov blízko seba a dodáva im jas. To je sladký, zvonivý zvuk typický pre ukulele.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 3, then string 4. Hear the jump up?
rows.translation: Struna 3, potom struna 4. Počujete skok nahor?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which open string plays the lowest note?
rows.translation: Ktorá prázdna struna hrá najnižší tón?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: With re-entrant tuning, C on string 3 is the lowest note on the ukulele.
rows.translation: Pri reentrantnom ladení je C na strune 3 najnižším tónom ukulele.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open, fret 2, fret 3: A, B, C.
rows.translation: Prázdna, pražec 2, pražec 3: A, B, C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
