rows.source: Fret 2 on string 3 is D. Fret 1 on string 2 is F. Fret 3 on string 2 is G, the same note as open string 4.
rows.translation: Pražec 2 na strune 3 je D. Pražec 1 na strune 2 je F. Pražec 3 na strune 2 je G, rovnaký tón ako prázdna struna 4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Fret 3 on string 2 matches which open string?
rows.translation: Ktorej prázdnej strune zodpovedá pražec 3 na strune 2?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Both are G. Two places, one note.
rows.translation: Oba sú G. Dve miesta, jeden tón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open strings, the high G and your first fretted notes. Take it slowly and let each note ring.
rows.translation: Prázdne struny, vysoké G a prvé tóny na pražcoch. Hrajte pomaly a každý tón nechajte znieť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Name the open strings from 4 to 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Entire pitch-letter answer sequence A E C G; preserve note identity and exact order. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Entire pitch-letter answer sequence E A D G; preserve note identity and exact order. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Entire pitch-letter answer sequence G D A E; preserve note identity and exact order. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: Which one is the open G string?
rows.translation: Ktorá z nich je prázdna struna G?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Všetky štyri prázdne struny od 4 po 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Your fretted notes: D, F, B, C.
rows.translation: Vaše tóny na pražcoch: D, F, B, C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: C uses your third finger on fret 3 of string 1. The other three strings ring open.
rows.translation: C hráte tretím prstom na pražci 3 struny 1. Ostatné tri struny znejú prázdne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Brush down across all four strings with the pad of your thumb, from string 4 to string 1. Keep your wrist loose.
rows.translation: Bruškom palca jemne prejdite nadol cez všetky štyri struny, od struny 4 po strunu 1. Zápästie nechajte uvoľnené.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which finger plays the C chord?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Your third finger reaches fret 3 without a stretch.
rows.translation: Tretí prst dočiahne na pražec 3 bez naťahovania.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Proper title of the external traditional song, not generic instruction; candidate for reviewer assessment of any established Slovak title. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: Row, Row, Row Your Boat needs only C. Strum it on the two big beats of every bar, then play the tune on strings 1 to 3.
rows.translation: Row, Row, Row Your Boat potrebuje iba C. Brnkajte na dve hlavné doby každého taktu, potom zahrajte melódiu na strunách 1 až 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The tune's five notes: C and D on string 3, E, F and G on string 2.
rows.translation: Päť tónov melódie: C a D na strune 3, E, F a G na strune 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A minor, F, G7 and G: with C, the chords behind countless songs.
rows.translation: A mol, F, G7 a G spolu s C sprevádzajú nespočetné piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A minor and your first change
rows.translation: A mol a vaša prvá zmena
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Put your second finger on fret 2 of string 4 and strum all four strings. A minor sounds darker than C.
rows.translation: Druhý prst položte na pražec 2 struny 4 a brnknite cez všetky štyri struny. A mol znie temnejšie než C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Lift the finger you don't need and place the new one while the last strum still rings. Look ahead to the next chord.
rows.translation: Kým posledné brnknutie ešte znie, zdvihnite nepotrebný prst a položte nový. Myslite dopredu na ďalší akord.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second finger on fret 2 of string 4. Strings 3 and 1 ring open.
rows.translation: Prvý prst na pražci 1 struny 2, druhý prst na pražci 2 struny 4. Struny 3 a 1 znejú prázdne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which chord shares a finger with F?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord má spoločný prst s F?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Your second finger sits on fret 2 of string 4 for both. Keep it down when you change.
rows.translation: Pri oboch máte druhý prst na pražci 2 struny 4. Pri zmene ho nechajte položený.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G7, the chord that leads home
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 2, second on fret 2 of string 3, third on fret 2 of string 1. Strum all four.
rows.translation: Prvý prst na pražci 1 struny 2, druhý na pražci 2 struny 3, tretí na pražci 2 struny 1. Brnknite cez všetky štyri.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A chord that wants to go home
rows.translation: Akord, ktorý sa chce vrátiť domov
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G7 sounds unfinished. Play C after it and the tension lets go. That pull is why so many songs put G7 before C.
rows.translation: G7 znie neuzavreto. Zahrajte po ňom C a napätie sa uvoľní. Preto toľko piesní dáva G7 pred C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Does this end at home or leave you hanging?
rows.translation: Končí to doma alebo zostáva napätie?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of string 3, second on fret 2 of string 1, third on fret 3 of string 2. Arch your fingers so string 4 rings.
rows.translation: Prvý prst na pražci 2 struny 3, druhý na pražci 2 struny 1, tretí na pražci 3 struny 2. Prsty zaoblite, aby struna 4 znela.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G and G7 both press which spot?
rows.translation: Ktoré miesto stláčate pri G aj G7?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Both chords put a finger on fret 2 of string 3. Use it as your anchor.
rows.translation: Pri oboch akordoch je prst na pražci 2 struny 3. Toto miesto používajte ako oporný bod.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which one is G7, the one with more tension?
rows.translation: Ktorý z nich je G7 s väčším napätím?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: C, A minor, F, G7 and G cover hundreds of songs. Make each shape clean, then keep the beat as you change.
rows.translation: C, A mol, F, G7 a G vystačia na stovky piesní. Každý hmat zahrajte čisto a pri zmenách držte rytmus.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which chord uses only one finger?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord hráte iba jedným prstom?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Steady downs, down-ups and the island strum.
rows.translation: Rovnomerné údery nadol, nadol-nahor a ostrovný rytmus.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Strum down on every beat: 1, 2, 3, 4. Use the nail of your index finger. When you change chords, your hand keeps moving.
rows.translation: Na každú dobu brnknite nadol: 1, 2, 3, 4. Použite necht ukazováka. Pri zmene akordov sa ruka stále pohybuje.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: What should your hand do while you change chords?
rows.translation: Čo má robiť ruka pri zmene akordov?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A late chord is better than a broken beat. Keep strumming, even if a string buzzes.
rows.translation: Neskorý akord je lepší než prerušený rytmus. Brnkajte ďalej, aj keď struna drnčí.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Strum down on the numbers, up on each and. Your hand never stops moving.
rows.translation: Počítajte 1 a 2 a 3 a 4 a. Na čísla brnkajte nadol, na každé „a“ nahor. Ruka sa nikdy nezastaví.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Up strums mostly catch strings 1 and 2. Brush them with the pad of your finger, a little softer than the downs.
rows.translation: Brnknutia nahor väčšinou zasiahnu struny 1 a 2. Bruškom prsta po nich prejdite trochu jemnejšie než pri úderoch nadol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Only at the end of a bar
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Down on 1, down-up on 2, down on 3, down-up on 4. Your hand still swings up after 1 and 3; it just misses the strings.
rows.translation: Nadol na 1, nadol-nahor na 2, nadol na 3, nadol-nahor na 4. Po 1 a 3 sa ruka stále pohne nahor, iba vynechá struny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: What does your hand do on the and of 1?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A silent up stroke keeps your hand in time for the next down.
rows.translation: Tichý pohyb nahor udrží ruku v rytme pre ďalší úder nadol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Conventional directional strum abbreviation D=down and U=up; adjacent full explanation translates every action. Review candidate, not approval. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: Down on 1, down-up on 2, skip the down on 3, then up, down-up. The missing down gives it a lilt.
rows.translation: Nadol na 1, nadol-nahor na 2, na 3 vynechajte nadol, potom nahor a nadol-nahor. Vynechaný úder mu dodáva hojdavosť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which strum do you skip in the island strum?
rows.translation: Ktoré brnknutie vynecháte v ostrovnom rytme?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Your hand still moves down on 3, it just misses the strings. That keeps the up after it in time.
rows.translation: Na 3 sa ruka stále pohne nadol, iba vynechá struny. Nasledujúci pohyb nahor tak zostane v rytme.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The last up strum of a bar can be loose or open. Use it to move to the next chord, so beat 1 lands clean.
rows.translation: Posledné brnknutie nahor v takte môže byť uvoľnené alebo cez prázdne struny. Využite ho na presun k ďalšiemu akordu, aby doba 1 zaznela čisto.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Downs, down-ups and the island strum. Keep your hand moving and let the chords come to you.
rows.translation: Údery nadol, nadol-nahor a ostrovný rytmus. Rukou stále pohybujte a nechajte akordy prísť k vám.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which pattern is the island strum?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Whole conventional D/U strum-direction pattern; adjacent localized prose explains all down/up motions. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Whole conventional D/U strum-direction pattern; adjacent localized prose explains all down/up motions. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: Play tunes note by note on strings 1 to 3.
rows.translation: Hrajte melódie tón po tóne na strunách 1 až 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: C D E F G A B C. Start on open string 3 and climb across strings 2 and 1. Every note sits in the first three frets.
rows.translation: C D E F G A B C. Začnite na prázdnej strune 3 a stúpajte cez struny 2 a 1. Každý tón leží v prvých troch pražcoch.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 3 open and fret 2, then string 2 open and fret 1.
rows.translation: Struna 3 prázdna a na pražci 2, potom struna 2 prázdna a na pražci 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 2 fret 3, then string 1: open, fret 2, fret 3.
rows.translation: Struna 2, pražec 3, potom struna 1: prázdna, pražec 2, pražec 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: How many different note names are in the scale?
rows.translation: Koľko rôznych názvov tónov má stupnica?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: C to C is eight notes, but the top C repeats the first. Seven names, then they start again.
rows.translation: Od C po C je osem tónov, ale vrchné C opakuje prvé. Sedem názvov, potom sa začínajú znova.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Beethoven wrote this tune in 1824. It moves mostly by step, from one note to the next, on strings 2 and 3.
rows.translation: Beethoven napísal túto melódiu v roku 1824. Väčšinou postupuje po krokoch, z tónu na tón, na strunách 2 a 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The opening: E E F G, G F E D.
rows.translation: Začiatok: E E F G, G F E D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The first line ends on D. Where does the second line end?
rows.translation: Prvý riadok končí na D. Kde končí druhý?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Same start, different finish. The second line comes home to C.
rows.translation: Rovnaký začiatok, iný koniec. Druhý riadok sa vracia domov na C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: External song proper title Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star; candidate for reviewer verification of any established Slovak title rather than generic instruction. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: This traditional tune leaps from C up to G, then walks back down one note at a time. Every line ends on a longer note.
rows.translation: Táto tradičná melódia skočí z C nahor na G a potom zostupuje tón po tóne. Každý riadok končí dlhším tónom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open string 3, string 2 fret 3, open string 1.
rows.translation: Prázdna struna 3, struna 2 na pražci 3, prázdna struna 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Does this phrase go up or down?
rows.translation: Ide táto fráza nahor alebo nadol?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Complete personal-name credit plus original year, without descriptive prose. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat, a half note two, a whole note four. Hold each one until the next note starts.
rows.translation: Štvrťová nota trvá jednu dobu, polová dve a celá štyri. Každú držte, kým sa nezačne ďalší tón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A dot adds half the note's length. A dotted half note lasts three beats; a dotted quarter lasts one and a half.
rows.translation: Bodka pridáva polovicu dĺžky noty. Polová nota s bodkou trvá tri doby, štvrťová s bodkou jeden a pol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: How many beats does a dotted half note last?
rows.translation: Koľko dôb trvá polová nota s bodkou?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: External song proper title Aura Lee; candidate for reviewer verification of any established Slovak title rather than generic instruction. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: "Aura Lee" was published in 1861, with music by George R. Poulton. Play it slowly and let each note ring into the next.
rows.translation: „Aura Lee“ vyšla v roku 1861; hudbu zložil George R. Poulton. Hrajte pomaly a nechajte každý tón doznievať do ďalšieho.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Fret 2 on string 2 is F sharp, one fret above F. A sharp raises a note by one fret.
rows.translation: Pražec 2 na strune 2 je Fis, o pražec nad F. Krížik zvyšuje tón o jeden pražec.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A sharp sign raises a note by how much?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Complete personal-name credit plus original year, without descriptive prose. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: Watch the note highway and keep your place, even if you miss a note. The beat goes on, so you do too.
rows.translation: Sledujte notovú dráhu a držte si miesto, aj keď tón miniete. Rytmus pokračuje, pokračujte aj vy.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Where is F sharp on string 2?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D minor, E minor, D, A and E7, then the four-chord song.
rows.translation: D mol, E mol, D, A a E7, potom pieseň so štyrmi akordmi.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Dm: F a jeden prst navyše
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Second finger on fret 2 of string 4, third on fret 2 of string 3, first on fret 1 of string 2. String 1 rings open.
rows.translation: Druhý prst na pražci 2 struny 4, tretí na pražci 2 struny 3, prvý na pražci 1 struny 2. Struna 1 znie prázdna.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which chord is D minor closest to?
rows.translation: Ktorému akordu je D mol najbližšie?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D minor is F with one more finger, on fret 2 of string 3.
rows.translation: D mol je F s ďalším prstom na pražci 2 struny 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: First finger on fret 2 of string 1, second on fret 3 of string 2, third on fret 4 of string 3. String 4 rings open.
rows.translation: Prvý prst na pražci 2 struny 1, druhý na pražci 3 struny 2, tretí na pražci 4 struny 3. Struna 4 znie prázdna.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: E minor and G both leave which string open?
rows.translation: Ktorú strunu nechávajú E mol aj G prázdnu?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Put fingers 1, 2 and 3 side by side on fret 2 of strings 4, 3 and 2. String 1 rings open.
rows.translation: Prsty 1, 2 a 3 položte vedľa seba na pražec 2 strún 4, 3 a 2. Struna 1 znie prázdna.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Second finger on fret 2 of string 4, first finger on fret 1 of string 3. Strings 2 and 1 ring open.
rows.translation: Druhý prst na pražci 2 struny 4, prvý prst na pražci 1 struny 3. Struny 2 a 1 znejú prázdne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which chord has three fingers on the same fret?
rows.translation: Pri ktorom akorde sú tri prsty na rovnakom pražci?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 4, second on fret 2 of string 3, third on fret 2 of string 1. String 2 rings open.
rows.translation: Prvý prst na pražci 1 struny 4, druhý na pražci 2 struny 3, tretí na pražci 2 struny 1. Struna 2 znie prázdna.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G7 pulls toward C. In the same way, E7 pulls toward A minor. Play them back to back and listen for the release.
rows.translation: G7 smeruje k C. Rovnako E7 smeruje k A mol. Zahrajte ich po sebe a počúvajte uvoľnenie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Entire Roman-numeral chord-degree progression; case encodes major/minor and must remain unchanged. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: Number the notes of the C scale and you can name chords by number: C is I, G is V, A minor is vi, F is IV. This order runs through countless songs.
rows.translation: Očíslujte tóny stupnice C a akordy môžete označovať číslami: C je I, G je V, A mol je vi, F je IV. Toto poradie používa nespočetné množstvo piesní.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In the key of C, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord je v tónine C na stupni IV?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Count up the scale from C: C, D, E, F. F is the fourth note, so F is the IV chord.
rows.translation: Počítajte po stupnici od C: C, D, E, F. F je štvrtý tón, preto je F akordom na stupni IV.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which chord is vi in C?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord je v C na stupni vi?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Lowercase numbers mean minor chords. The sixth note of C major is A.
rows.translation: Malé rímske číslice označujú molové akordy. Šiesty tón C dur je A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: C, A minor, F, G, G7, D minor, E minor, D, A and E7. Clean shapes first, then steady strums.
rows.translation: C, A mol, F, G, G7, D mol, E mol, D, A a E7. Najprv čisté hmaty, potom rovnomerné brnkanie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In the key of C, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord je v tónine C na stupni V?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Four public-domain songs with melody and chords.
rows.translation: Štyri autorskoprávne voľné piesne s melódiou a akordmi.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Stephen Foster wrote this song in 1848. It counts in two: 1 and 2 and. Most notes are quick eighth notes.
rows.translation: Stephen Foster napísal túto pieseň v roku 1848. Počíta sa na dve: 1 a 2 a. Väčšina tónov sú rýchle osminové noty.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The opening: C D E G, G A G E.
rows.translation: Začiatok: C D E G, G A G E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: External song proper title Camptown Races; candidate for reviewer verification of any established Slovak title rather than generic instruction. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: Another Foster song, from 1850. The melody bounces between G and E, and a short two-note call answers each line.
rows.translation: Ďalšia Fosterova pieseň, z roku 1850. Melódia poskakuje medzi G a E a na každý riadok odpovedá krátke dvojtónové zvolanie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G G E G A G E.
rows.translation: G G E G A G E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Entire ordered note-letter exercise with original punctuation, no prose. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: Like most songs in C, it comes home to C.
rows.translation: Ako väčšina piesní v C sa vracia domov na C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Complete personal-name credit plus original year, without descriptive prose. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: Count 1 2 3, 1 2 3, with the weight on 1. This is waltz time. "Clementine", first printed in 1884, sways in three.
rows.translation: Počítajte 1 2 3, 1 2 3 s dôrazom na 1. To je valčíkové metrum. „Clementine“, prvýkrát vydaná v roku 1884, sa kolíše na tri.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 2 fret 1, open 3, open 1, then string 1 frets 3 and 1.
rows.translation: Struna 2, pražec 1, prázdna 3, prázdna 1, potom struna 1 na pražcoch 3 a 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: First finger on fret 1 of string 1. With F, it carries the whole song.
rows.translation: Prvý prst na pražci 1 struny 1. Spolu s F sprevádza celú pieseň.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: External song proper title Red River Valley; candidate for reviewer verification of any established Slovak title rather than generic instruction. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: This traditional tune was in print by 1896. Each line ends on a long note, so count it out before the next one.
rows.translation: Táto tradičná melódia bola tlačou vydaná najneskôr v roku 1896. Každý riadok končí dlhým tónom, preto ho pred ďalším riadne odpočítajte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open 3, string 2 fret 1, open 1, string 2 fret 3, string 1 frets 1 and 3.
rows.translation: Prázdna 3, struna 2 na pražci 1, prázdna 1, struna 2 na pražci 3, struna 1 na pražcoch 1 a 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The last line starts D, C sharp, C. How do those notes move?
rows.translation: Posledný riadok začína D, Cis, C. Ako sa tieto tóny pohybujú?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Down one fret at a time
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Each note is one fret lower on string 3: fret 2, fret 1, open.
rows.translation: Každý tón je na strune 3 o pražec nižšie: pražec 2, pražec 1, prázdna.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: When you strum a song, the melody lives in your head or in a friend's voice. Change chords where the tune leans, and keep the strum steady.
rows.translation: Pri akordovom sprievode znie melódia vo vašej hlave alebo v hlase priateľa. Akordy meňte tam, kde sa o ne melódia opiera, a brnkajte rovnomerne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A song in F usually ends on which chord?
rows.translation: Ktorým akordom sa zvyčajne končí pieseň v F?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Complete standardized chord symbol C7, matching displayed pitch and chord notation; no untranslated prose. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: Songs come home to their key chord. In F, that's F.
rows.translation: Piesne sa vracajú domov k základnému akordu tóniny. V F je to F.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Four songs, a handful of chords and three strums. Play them like a small concert: count in, keep going, finish strong.
rows.translation: Štyri piesne, zopár akordov a tri rytmy. Zahrajte ich ako malý koncert: odpočítajte, pokračujte a presvedčivo skončite.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: B flat, D7, B minor and G minor, the keys of G, F and D, and moving a song to any key.
rows.translation: Znížené B, D7, B mol a G mol, tóniny G, F a D a presun piesne do ľubovoľnej tóniny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 2 and 1 at fret 1. Finger 2 goes on string 3, fret 2, and finger 3 on string 4, fret 3.
rows.translation: Prst 1 položte cez struny 2 a 1 na pražci 1. Prst 2 patrí na strunu 3, pražec 2 a prst 3 na strunu 4, pražec 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which chord shares finger 1's spot on string 2 with B flat?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord má prst 1 na rovnakom mieste struny 2 ako znížené B?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: F also puts finger 1 on string 2, fret 1. Keep it there as you change.
rows.translation: Aj pri F je prst 1 na strune 2, pražci 1. Pri zmene ho nechajte na mieste.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D7 and the key of G
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D7: a barre and one finger
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 4, 3 and 2 at fret 2, and put finger 2 on string 1, fret 3.
rows.translation: Prst 1 položte cez struny 4, 3 a 2 na pražci 2 a prst 2 na strunu 1, pražec 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In G, the chords G, C and D7 do most of the work, with E minor for a darker color. D7 pulls back to G the way G7 pulls to C.
rows.translation: V G väčšinu práce odvedú G, C a D7; E mol pridá temnejšiu farbu. D7 smeruje späť k G tak, ako G7 smeruje k C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: B minor and the key of D
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Lay finger 1 across strings 3, 2 and 1 at fret 2, then reach finger 3 to string 4, fret 4.
rows.translation: Prst 1 položte cez struny 3, 2 a 1 na pražci 2 a prstom 3 dočiahnite na strunu 4, pražec 4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D and B minor both press fret 2 on which strings?
rows.translation: Na ktorých strunách držia D aj B mol pražec 2?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Both chords hold fret 2 on strings 3 and 2. Only the outer strings change.
rows.translation: Oba akordy držia pražec 2 na strunách 3 a 2. Menia sa iba krajné struny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In D, the chords D, G and A7 carry the song, and B minor adds a sad one. A7 is a single finger: string 3, fret 1.
rows.translation: V D pieseň nesú D, G a A7 a B mol pridá smutný akord. A7 hráte jediným prstom: struna 3, pražec 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A song's chords are steps of its key: I, IV and V. Change key and the numbers stay. In C that's C, F and G7; in G, it's G, C and D7; in F, F, B flat and C7.
rows.translation: Akordy piesne stoja na stupňoch tóniny: I, IV a V. Pri zmene tóniny čísla zostávajú. V C sú to C, F a G7; v G sú to G, C a D7; v F sú to F, znížené B a C7.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In the key of F, which chord is IV?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord je v tónine F na stupni IV?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Count up from F: F, G, A, B flat. The fourth note is B flat.
rows.translation: Počítajte od F: F, G, A, znížené B. Štvrtým tónom je znížené B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: If a song sits too high or too low to sing, move it to another key. Same numbers, same song, just a better fit for the voice.
rows.translation: Ak je pieseň na spev príliš vysoko alebo nízko, presuňte ju do inej tóniny. Rovnaké čísla, rovnaká pieseň, iba lepšie prispôsobená hlasu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In the key of D, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord je v tónine D na stupni V?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Count up from D: D, E, F sharp, G, A. A is the fifth note, so A7 is the V chord.
rows.translation: Počítajte od D: D, E, Fis, G, A. A je piaty tón, preto je A7 akordom na stupni V.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Finger 2 on string 3, fret 2, finger 3 on string 2, fret 3, and finger 1 on string 1, fret 1. String 4 rings open.
rows.translation: Prst 2 na strune 3, pražci 2, prst 3 na strune 2, pražci 3 a prst 1 na strune 1, pražci 1. Struna 4 znie prázdna.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D minor's family is D minor, G minor and A7. A7 pulls home to D minor, the way E7 pulls to A minor.
rows.translation: Rodinu D mol tvoria D mol, G mol a A7. A7 smeruje domov k D mol tak, ako E7 smeruje k A mol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: No new ideas: B flat, D7, B minor and G minor, and the keys of C, G, F and D. Clean shapes first, then a steady strum.
rows.translation: Nič nové: znížené B, D7, B mol a G mol a tóniny C, G, F a D. Najprv čisté hmaty, potom rovnomerné brnkanie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In the key of G, which chord is V?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord je v tónine G na stupni V?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The chunk, the island strum with a backbeat, swing and the ragtime chords, accents in 3-3-2, and the waltz.
rows.translation: Tlmený úder, ostrovný rytmus s dôrazom na ľahké doby, swing, ragtime akordy, akcenty 3-3-2 a valčík.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A chunk is a strum that stops dead. Strum down and let the side of your palm land on the strings at the same moment: a short, dry click, like a snare drum.
rows.translation: Tlmený úder je brnknutie, ktoré hneď zanikne. Brnknite nadol a súčasne nechajte hranu dlane dopadnúť na struny: krátke suché cvaknutie ako malý bubon.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Strum down on 1, chunk on 2, down-up on 3, chunk on 4. The chunks fall where a drummer hits the snare.
rows.translation: Brnknite nadol na 1, tlmene na 2, nadol-nahor na 3 a tlmene na 4. Tlmené údery sú tam, kde bubeník hrá na malý bubon.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Na ktoré doby patria tlmené údery?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Two and four are the backbeat, where the snare drum plays. A chunk there gives the strum a drummer's punch.
rows.translation: Druhá a štvrtá tvoria backbeat, kde hrá malý bubon. Tlmený úder na týchto dobách dodá brnkaniu bubenícku údernosť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Swap one down for a chunk
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Take the island strum, D, DU, UDU, and turn the down on 2 into a chunk. The rhythm stays the same; the groove gets a backbeat.
rows.translation: Vezmite ostrovný rytmus D, DU, UDU a úder nadol na 2 zmeňte na tlmený. Rytmus zostane rovnaký, ale získa backbeat.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In this strum, which stroke becomes the chunk?
rows.translation: Ktorý pohyb sa v tomto rytme zmení na tlmený úder?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Beat 1 rings out, beat 2 clicks. Everything else stays where the island strum had it.
rows.translation: Doba 1 znie, doba 2 cvakne. Všetko ostatné zostáva na miestach ostrovného rytmu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Swing splits each beat unevenly: a long down, then a short up. Say hum-pty, dum-pty as you strum. It's the bounce of old ukulele tunes.
rows.translation: Swing delí dobu nerovnomerne: dlho nadol, potom krátko nahor. Pri brnkaní hovorte „dáá-da, dáá-da“. To je hojdavosť starých ukulelových melódií.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: C, A7, D7, G7, then home to C. Each seventh chord pulls to the next, a little chain of tension. It powered countless songs a century ago.
rows.translation: C, A7, D7, G7 a potom domov na C. Každý septakord smeruje k ďalšiemu ako malá reťaz napätia. Pred storočím poháňala nespočetné piesne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which chord does D7 pull toward here?
rows.translation: Ku ktorému akordu tu smeruje D7?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D7 leads to G, and G7 leads home to C. Each chord sets up the next.
rows.translation: D7 vedie ku G a G7 domov ku C. Každý akord pripravuje nasledujúci.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Strum steady down-up eighths, but hit three of them harder: 1, the and of 2, and 4. The accents fall 3, 3 and 2 eighths apart.
rows.translation: Brnkajte rovnomerné osminy nadol-nahor, ale tri zdôraznite: 1, „a“ doby 2 a 4. Akcenty sú od seba vzdialené 3, 3 a 2 osminy.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Count 1 2 3, 1 2 3, 1 2 across the bar's eight eighths. Each 1 is an accent.
rows.translation: Cez osem osmín taktu počítajte 1 2 3, 1 2 3, 1 2. Každá 1 je akcent.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: George Formby's split stroke on the banjo ukulele puts its big strums in the same three places, with single strings in between. Master the accents first.
rows.translation: Delený úder Georgea Formbyho na banjovom ukulele kladie silné brnknutia na tie isté tri miesta a medzi ne jednotlivé struny. Najprv zvládnite akcenty.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In three, strum down on 1, then down-up on 2 and on 3: D, DU, DU. Lean on 1 so the sway is clear.
rows.translation: V trojdobom metre brnknite nadol na 1, potom nadol-nahor na 2 aj na 3: D, DU, DU. Zdôraznite 1, aby bolo kolísanie jasné.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: How many strums fill this bar of three?
rows.translation: Koľko brnknutí vyplní tento trojdobý takt?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Down on 1, then down-up on 2 and on 3: one plus two plus two.
rows.translation: Nadol na 1, potom nadol-nahor na 2 a na 3: jeden plus dva plus dva.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: No new ideas: chunks, the island strum with a chunk, swing, the 3-3-2 accents and the waltz. Keep the hand moving and let the accents speak.
rows.translation: Nič nové: tlmené údery, ostrovný rytmus s tlmením, swing, akcenty 3-3-2 a valčík. Rukou stále pohybujte a nechajte hovoriť akcenty.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In a swing strum, each beat splits into…
rows.translation: Pri swingovom brnkaní sa každá doba delí na…
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: One finger per string, rolling patterns, the alternating thumb, and a tune picked from inside its chords.
rows.translation: Jeden prst na strunu, plynulé vzory, striedavý palec a melódia vybrnkávaná zvnútra akordov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Rest your thumb on string 4, index on string 3, middle on string 2 and ring finger on string 1. Each one plucks only its own string.
rows.translation: Palec oprite o strunu 4, ukazovák o strunu 3, prostredník o strunu 2 a prstenník o strunu 1. Každý brnká iba na vlastnú strunu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Thumb, index, middle, ring: strings 4, 3, 2 and 1.
rows.translation: Palec, ukazovák, prostredník, prstenník: struny 4, 3, 2 a 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Thumb on 4, index on 3, middle on 2, ring on 1: one finger per string.
rows.translation: Palec na 4, ukazovák na 3, prostredník na 2, prstenník na 1: jeden prst na strunu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Because string 4 is a high G, the pattern zigzags: high, low, then climbing. That sparkle is the sound of fingerpicked ukulele.
rows.translation: Keďže struna 4 je vysoké G, vzor ide cikcak: vysoko, nízko a potom stúpa. Toto iskrenie je zvukom ukulele hraného prstami.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A minor, F, C, G7, in eighths
rows.translation: A mol, F, C, G7 v osminách
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Pluck strings 4, 3, 2 and 1, then come back on 2 and 3: thumb, index, middle, ring, middle, index. Six notes fill a bar of three.
rows.translation: Brnkajte na struny 4, 3, 2 a 1 a potom späť na 2 a 3: palec, ukazovák, prostredník, prstenník, prostredník, ukazovák. Šesť tónov vyplní trojdobý takt.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: After the ring finger plucks string 1, which finger comes next?
rows.translation: Ktorý prst nasleduje po prstenníku na strune 1?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The roll turns around at the top: ring on string 1, then middle on 2 and index on 3.
rows.translation: Na vrchu sa smer obráti: prstenník na strune 1, potom prostredník na 2 a ukazovák na 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Land the new chord as the thumb starts the next bar. The fingers keep rolling; only the shape under them changes.
rows.translation: Nový akord položte, keď palec začína ďalší takt. Prsty pokračujú vo vybrnkávaní; mení sa iba hmat pod nimi.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: C, A minor, D minor, G7
rows.translation: C, A mol, D mol, G7
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Now the thumb rocks between strings 3 and 4 on the beats while your fingers pluck strings 2 and 1 in between. It's the ukulele's version of Travis picking.
rows.translation: Palec teraz na doby strieda struny 3 a 4, kým prsty medzi nimi brnkajú na struny 2 a 1. Je to ukulelová verzia Travisovho vybrnkávania.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In this pattern, what does the thumb do?
rows.translation: Čo robí palec v tomto vzore?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The thumb keeps the pulse, a note on every beat, while the fingers fill the gaps.
rows.translation: Palec drží pulz, tón na každú dobu, zatiaľ čo prsty vypĺňajú medzery.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Entire chord-symbol progression C,F,G7,C, no prose; order and seventh designation are musical data. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: Hold the chord, pick the tune
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In chord melody, your fretting hand holds the chord and you pick the tune from inside it. Hold F, and C, F and A are already under your fingers.
rows.translation: Pri akordovej melódii ruka na hmatníku drží akord a vy z neho vybrnkávate melódiu. Držte F a C, F aj A už máte pod prstami.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Hold F: open string 3, string 2 at fret 1, open string 1. That's how Amazing Grace begins.
rows.translation: Držte F: prázdna struna 3, struna 2 na pražci 1, prázdna struna 1. Tak sa začína Amazing Grace.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: When the tune leaves the chord, reach with a free finger. Over F, finger 3 takes G on string 2, fret 3, then lifts as the tune comes back.
rows.translation: Keď melódia opustí akord, dočiahnite voľným prstom. Nad F hrá prst 3 G na strune 2, pražci 3 a zdvihne sa, keď sa melódia vráti.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Over B flat, where is the tune's D?
rows.translation: Kde je melodické D nad akordom zníženého B?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: B flat's finger 2 already holds D on string 3, fret 2. The tune walks right through the chord.
rows.translation: Pri zníženom B už prst 2 drží D na strune 3, pražci 2. Melódia prechádza priamo akordom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Rolled chords between the verses and the melody inside the chords. The tune is the hymn New Britain, printed in 1829, with John Newton's words.
rows.translation: Vybrnkávané akordy medzi slohami a melódia vnútri akordov. Ide o melódiu hymnu New Britain, vydanú v roku 1829, so slovami Johna Newtona.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Why does the intro's last bar end on a long note?
rows.translation: Prečo posledný takt úvodu končí dlhým tónom?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: To leave room for the pickup
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The verse starts a beat early, on its pickup. A long last note keeps that beat clear.
rows.translation: Sloha začína o dobu skôr, predtaktom. Dlhý posledný tón ponechá túto dobu voľnú.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: No new ideas: one finger per string, the out-and-back roll, the alternating thumb and the melody inside the chord.
rows.translation: Nič nové: jeden prst na strunu, vybrnkávanie tam a späť, striedavý palec a melódia v akorde.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Thumb, index, middle, ring play which strings?
rows.translation: Na ktorých strunách hrajú palec, ukazovák, prostredník a prstenník?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Four public-domain songs arranged for ukulele, and how to lead a room through them.
rows.translation: Štyri autorskoprávne voľné piesne upravené pre ukulele a vedenie spoločného spevu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Down by the Riverside, first printed in 1918, is made for singing together. On ukulele it sits in G, with G, C and D7, and a gospel A sharp on string 1, fret 1.
rows.translation: Down by the Riverside, prvýkrát vydaný v roku 1918, je stvorený na spoločný spev. Na ukulele je v G s akordmi G, C a D7 a gospelovým Ais na strune 1, pražci 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Down by the riverside: B, B, A sharp, B, then A and G.
rows.translation: „Down by the riverside“: B, B, Ais, B, potom A a G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: External traditional work title The Water Is Wide; candidate for reviewer assessment of established Slovak naming. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: Cecil Sharp printed this English ballad in 1906. In F it uses F, B flat, C and C7, G minor and D minor, often two to a bar. Pick the chords between verses and let them ring.
rows.translation: Cecil Sharp vydal túto anglickú baladu v roku 1906. V F používa F, znížené B, C a C7, G mol a D mol, často dva akordy za takt. Medzi slohami akordy vybrnkávajte a nechajte znieť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The water is wide: open string 3, F at fret 1 twice, G at fret 3, then open A.
rows.translation: „The water is wide“: prázdna struna 3, dvakrát F na pražci 1, G na pražci 3, potom prázdne A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Many bars here change halfway. Count the verse in two-beat halves, one chord each, and change on every other click.
rows.translation: Mnohé takty sa tu menia v polovici. Slohu počítajte v dvojdobových poloviciach, po jednom akorde, a meňte na každý druhý klik.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Before the first strum, count out loud at the song's tempo: one, two, three, four. Everyone starts together, at the speed you set.
rows.translation: Pred prvým brnknutím nahlas odpočítajte v tempe piesne: raz, dva, tri, štyri. Všetci začnú spolu rýchlosťou, ktorú určíte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Miss a chord? Keep strumming and catch the next one. A singing room follows the beat, not every note.
rows.translation: Minuli ste akord? Brnkajte ďalej a chyťte nasledujúci. Spievajúca miestnosť sleduje rytmus, nie každý tón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: You fumble a change mid-song. What now?
rows.translation: Uprostred piesne pokazíte zmenu. Čo teraz?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Keep strumming and catch the next chord
rows.translation: Brnkať ďalej a chytiť ďalší akord
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The beat carries everyone. Drop a chord if you must, never the rhythm.
rows.translation: Rytmus nesie všetkých. Ak musíte, vynechajte akord, nikdy rytmus.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Before the last line, nod or call out last time. Slow the final line a touch and let the last chord ring.
rows.translation: Pred posledným riadkom prikývnite alebo zavolajte „naposledy“. Záverečný riadok mierne spomaľte a posledný akord nechajte znieť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: External traditional work title Molly Malone; candidate for reviewer assessment of established Slovak naming. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: Molly Malone was printed in 1876. It's a waltz: lean on beat 1 and let the tune sway. In F it uses F, G minor, C7, D minor and G7.
rows.translation: Molly Malone vyšla v roku 1876. Je to valčík: zdôraznite dobu 1 a nechajte melódiu kolísať. V F používa F, G mol, C7, D mol a G7.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In Dublin's fair city: open string 3, F at fret 1 four times, open A, back to F.
rows.translation: „In Dublin's fair city“: prázdna struna 3, štyrikrát F na pražci 1, prázdne A, späť na F.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which chord pulls hardest back to F?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord najsilnejšie smeruje späť k F?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: C7 is the V chord in F. Its seventh leans straight back home.
rows.translation: C7 je v F akordom na stupni V. Jeho septima smeruje priamo domov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: External traditional work title The Skye Boat Song; candidate for reviewer assessment of established Slovak naming. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: This rowing song is in six-eight: six quick counts to a bar, felt as two big sways. Count 1 2 3, 4 5 6, and lean on 1 and 4.
rows.translation: Táto veslárska pieseň je v šesťosminovom metre: šesť rýchlych počítaní za takt cítených ako dve veľké kolísania. Počítajte 1 2 3, 4 5 6 a zdôraznite 1 a 4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In six-eight, where do the big beats fall?
rows.translation: Kde sú hlavné doby v šesťosminovom metre?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Six eighths group in two threes: 1 2 3, 4 5 6. The first of each three carries the sway.
rows.translation: Šesť osmín sa zoskupí do dvoch trojíc: 1 2 3, 4 5 6. Prvá z každej trojice nesie kolísanie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Full credited proper personal name with original honorific and year, not instructional prose. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: No new ideas: four songs, counted in, kept going and finished clean. Play them back to back like a short concert.
rows.translation: Nič nové: štyri piesne s odpočítaním, plynulým priebehom a čistým záverom. Zahrajte ich za sebou ako krátky koncert.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: From open strings to walking lines and grooves
rows.translation: Od prázdnych strún po kráčajúce basové linky a rytmy
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Meet E A D G, pluck with two fingers, play your first notes and a song.
rows.translation: Spoznajte E A D G, brnkajte dvoma prstami a zahrajte prvé tóny aj pieseň.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The thickest string is the lowest. It sits nearest your face when you play. We call it string 4.
rows.translation: Najhrubšia struna znie najnižšie. Pri hraní je najbližšie k tvári. Voláme ju struna 4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Strings count from the thinnest (1) to the thickest (4).
rows.translation: Struny sa počítajú od najtenšej (1) po najhrubšiu (4).
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: From thick to thin: E, A, D, G. They match the four lowest guitar strings, an octave down. Try: Every Amp Drives Grooves.
rows.translation: Od hrubej po tenkú: E, A, D, G. Zodpovedajú štyrom najnižším gitarovým strunám o oktávu nižšie. Pomôcka: Eva A Dávid Grilujú.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Pluck with the pads of your index and middle fingers, taking turns. Rest your thumb on the pickup or on string 4.
rows.translation: Striedavo brnkajte bruškami ukazováka a prostredníka. Palec oprite o snímač alebo strunu 4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Pluck across the string, not up and away. Your finger comes to rest on the next thicker string. This rest stroke sounds full and strong.
rows.translation: Brnkajte cez strunu, nie nahor od nej. Prst sa oprie o vedľajšiu hrubšiu strunu. Tento opretý úder znie plno a silno.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Where does your finger stop after a rest stroke?
rows.translation: Kde sa prst zastaví po opretom údere?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In the air above the strings
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Pulling through to the next string keeps the motion small and the tone strong.
rows.translation: Prechod až k vedľajšej strune udržuje pohyb malý a tón silný.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open E, fret 3, open A, fret 3.
rows.translation: Prázdne E, pražec 3, prázdne A, pražec 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open strings, two-finger plucking and your first fretted notes. Keep your fingers taking turns and let each note ring.
rows.translation: Prázdne struny, brnkanie dvoma prstami a prvé tóny na pražcoch. Prsty striedajte a každý tón nechajte znieť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which one is the open E string?
rows.translation: Ktorá z nich je prázdna struna E?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb needs three notes: B at fret 2 on string 3, open A, and G at fret 3 on string 4. Second finger for B, third for G.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb potrebuje tri tóny: B na pražci 2 struny 3, prázdne A a G na pražci 3 struny 4. Druhý prst na B, tretí na G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 3, fret 2, second finger. That's B.
rows.translation: Struna 3, pražec 2, druhý prst. To je B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: B A G A B B B: string 3, then G on string 4.
rows.translation: B A G A B B B: struna 3, potom G na strune 4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Play the root of each chord and lock in with the beat.
rows.translation: Hrajte základný tón každého akordu presne na dobu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Every chord is built on one note, its root. The root of an A chord is A. Bass players play roots so the band knows where home is.
rows.translation: Každý akord je postavený na jednom tóne, svojom základnom tóne. Pri akorde A je to A. Basgitaristi hrajú základné tóny, aby kapela vedela, kde je domov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: What is the root of a D chord?
rows.translation: Aký je základný tón akordu D?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Root or not? Listen to the lowest note.
rows.translation: Je to základný tón alebo nie? Počúvajte najnižší tón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Roots of A, D and E: all open strings.
rows.translation: Základné tóny A, D a E: všetky na prázdnych strunách.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Roots of A, D and E
rows.translation: Základné tóny A, D a E
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Bass and kick drum land together. Aim for the exact moment of the click, not just near it. Timbre shows if you're early or late.
rows.translation: Basgitara a veľký bubon zaznievajú spolu. Mierte presne na klik, nie iba blízko neho. Timbre ukáže, či hráte priskoro alebo neskoro.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: You keep landing a little after the click. What helps?
rows.translation: Stále hráte trochu po kliku. Čo pomôže?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Feel the beat coming and pluck a touch earlier
rows.translation: Cítiť príchod doby a brnknúť trochu skôr
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Your finger needs a moment to move. Start the pluck slightly earlier so the note speaks right on the beat.
rows.translation: Prst potrebuje chvíľu na pohyb. Začnite brnkať o trochu skôr, aby tón zaznel presne na dobu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A rest is a beat of silence. Stop the string by touching it lightly with a free finger, so the rest is as clean as the note.
rows.translation: Pomlčka je doba ticha. Strunu zastavte ľahkým dotykom voľného prsta, aby bola pomlčka rovnako čistá ako tón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: How do you stop a ringing string?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Touch it lightly with a free finger
rows.translation: Ľahko sa jej dotknúť voľným prstom
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Muting is half of bass playing. Rest a finger lightly on the string to silence it.
rows.translation: Tlmenie je polovica basgitarovej hry. Prst ľahko položte na strunu, aby stíchla.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A chord chart tells you which chord is coming. Play its root on every beat until the chart changes.
rows.translation: Akordový zápis ukáže, ktorý akord prichádza. Hrajte jeho základný tón na každú dobu, kým sa zápis nezmení.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G on string 4 fret 3, C on string 3 fret 3, then open D.
rows.translation: G na strune 4, pražci 3, C na strune 3, pražci 3, potom prázdne D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Complete ordered pitch/chord-symbol sequence G, C, D, G; exact symbols and order are the exercise, with no prose. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: The chart says C. Which note do you play?
rows.translation: V zápise je C. Ktorý tón hráte?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Roots on the beat, clean rests and changes right on time. Keep your plucking fingers taking turns the whole way.
rows.translation: Základné tóny na dobu, čisté pomlčky a zmeny presne načas. Brnkajúce prsty po celý čas striedajte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: What is the root of an E chord?
rows.translation: Aký je základný tón akordu E?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Complete ordered pitch/chord-symbol sequence A, D, E; exact symbols and order are the exercise, with no prose. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: Every note from fret 0 to 5 on strings 4 and 3, and the major scale shape.
rows.translation: Každý tón od pražca 0 po 5 na strunách 4 a 3 a hmat durovej stupnice.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: E to A on one string
rows.translation: Od E po A na jednej strune
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: On string 4, each fret is one note higher: E, F, F sharp, G, G sharp, then A at fret 5. Fret 5 sounds the same as open string 3.
rows.translation: Na strune 4 každý pražec zvýši tón: E, F, Fis, G, Gis, potom A na pražci 5. Pražec 5 znie rovnako ako prázdna struna 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which fret on string 4 matches open string 3?
rows.translation: Ktorý pražec na strune 4 zodpovedá prázdnej strune 3?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Both are A. Each string is tuned to fret 5 of the string below it.
rows.translation: Oba sú A. Každá struna je naladená ako pražec 5 vedľajšej hlbšej struny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Od A po D na strune 3
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 3 works the same way: A, B flat, B, C, C sharp, then D at fret 5. Fret 5 matches open string 2.
rows.translation: Struna 3 funguje rovnako: A, znížené B, B, C, Cis, potom D na pražci 5. Pražec 5 zodpovedá prázdnej strune 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Aký tón je na pražci 3 struny 3?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A on fret 5 of string 4 sounds the same as open string 3. Open strings ring longer; fretted notes are easier to stop and shape.
rows.translation: A na pražci 5 struny 4 znie rovnako ako prázdna struna 3. Prázdne struny znejú dlhšie, tóny na pražcoch sa ľahšie zastavujú a tvarujú.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Fret 5 on string 4, then open string 3.
rows.translation: Pražec 5 na strune 4, potom prázdna struna 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Fret 5 on string 3, then open string 2.
rows.translation: Pražec 5 na strune 3, potom prázdna struna 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which fret on string 3 matches open string 2?
rows.translation: Ktorý pražec na strune 3 zodpovedá prázdnej strune 2?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Both are D. Each string is tuned to fret 5 of the string below it.
rows.translation: Oba sú D. Každá struna je naladená ako pražec 5 vedľajšej hlbšej struny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Let each finger cover one fret: index on fret 2, middle on 3, ring on 4, little on 5. Your thumb rests behind the neck, across from your middle finger.
rows.translation: Každému prstu prideľte jeden pražec: ukazovák na 2, prostredník na 3, prstenník na 4 a malíček na 5. Palec spočíva za krkom oproti prostredníku.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Start on G, fret 3 of string 4, with your middle finger. Climb across three strings: G A B C D E F sharp G. The same shape works from any root.
rows.translation: Začnite prostredníkom na G, pražci 3 struny 4. Stúpajte cez tri struny: G A B C D E Fis G. Rovnaký hmat funguje od každého základného tónu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Middle, little; then index, middle on string 3.
rows.translation: Prostredník, malíček; potom ukazovák a prostredník na strune 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Little finger; then index, ring, little on string 2.
rows.translation: Malíček; potom ukazovák, prstenník a malíček na strune 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: You move the shape so it starts on fret 5 of string 4. Which scale is it now?
rows.translation: Posuniete hmat tak, aby začínal na pražci 5 struny 4. Ktorú stupnicu teraz hráte?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Fret 5 on string 4 is A, so the same shape plays A major.
rows.translation: Pražec 5 na strune 4 je A, preto rovnaký hmat hrá A dur.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Ode to Joy works on bass too. Play it in G on strings 4 and 3, with your hand in the scale shape: index on fret 2.
rows.translation: Óda na radosť funguje aj na basgitare. Hrajte ju v G na strunách 4 a 3 s rukou v stupnicovej polohe: ukazovák pri pražci 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The first line ends on A. Where does the second line end?
rows.translation: Prvý riadok končí na A. Kde končí druhý?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Same start, different finish. The second line comes home to G.
rows.translation: Rovnaký začiatok, iný koniec. Druhý riadok sa vracia domov na G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Name it, find it, play it
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Frets 0 to 5 on strings 4 and 3 give you every note from E up to D. Say each note's name as you play it.
rows.translation: Pražce 0 až 5 na strunách 4 a 3 ponúkajú každý tón od E nahor po D. Pri hraní vyslovujte názvy tónov.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Aký tón je na pražci 3 struny 4?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: F, A, B, D on strings 4 and 3.
rows.translation: F, A, B, D na strunách 4 a 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Outline chords with the root, its fifth and its octave.
rows.translation: Načrtnite akordy základným tónom, kvintou a oktávou.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: One string over, two frets up
rows.translation: O strunu vedľa, o dva pražce vyššie
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The fifth of a chord sits on the next thinner string, two frets higher than the root. For open A, that's fret 2 of string 2: E.
rows.translation: Kvinta akordu leží na vedľajšej tenšej strune o dva pražce vyššie než základný tón. Pri prázdnom A je to pražec 2 struny 2: E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Prázdna struna 3, potom struna 2 na pražci 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Prázdna struna 4, potom struna 3 na pražci 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: What is the fifth of D?
rows.translation: Ktorý tón je kvintou od D?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Count up the D major scale: D, E, F sharp, G, A. A is the fifth note.
rows.translation: Počítajte po D dur: D, E, Fis, G, A. A je piaty tón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Prázdna struna 2, potom struna 1 na pražci 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Základný tón a kvinta nad akordmi
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Play the root on beat 1 and the fifth on beat 3. Two notes per bar outline the whole chord and leave room for the drums.
rows.translation: Na dobu 1 zahrajte základný tón, na dobu 3 kvintu. Dva tóny za takt načrtnú celý akord a nechajú priestor bicím.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: A, D, E v polových notách
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In a root-fifth pattern, which note lands on beat 1?
rows.translation: Ktorý tón hráte na dobu 1 vo vzore základný tón–kvinta?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The root on beat 1 tells everyone which chord they're in.
rows.translation: Základný tón na dobu 1 všetkým oznámi, v ktorom akorde sú.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Two strings over, two frets up
rows.translation: O dve struny vedľa, o dva pražce vyššie
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The octave is the same note name, higher. From a root on string 4 or 3, go two strings thinner and two frets up. Open A becomes fret 2 of string 1.
rows.translation: Oktáva je vyšší tón s rovnakým názvom. Od základného tónu na strune 4 alebo 3 prejdite o dve struny k tenším a o dva pražce vyššie. Z prázdneho A je pražec 2 struny 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Prázdna struna 3, potom struna 1 na pražci 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Prázdna struna 4, potom struna 2 na pražci 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Majú tóny rovnaký názov alebo iný?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G is on fret 3 of string 4. Where is the G an octave higher?
rows.translation: G je na pražci 3 struny 4. Kde je G o oktávu vyššie?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Two strings thinner, two frets up: fret 5 of string 2. Open string 1 is the same G.
rows.translation: O dve struny k tenším, o dva pražce vyššie: pražec 5 struny 2. Prázdna struna 1 je to isté G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Root, fifth, octave, then back to the fifth. Over A: open string 3, fret 2 of string 2, fret 2 of string 1. It fits any major or minor chord.
rows.translation: Základný tón, kvinta, oktáva a späť ku kvinte. Nad A: prázdna struna 3, pražec 2 struny 2, pražec 2 struny 1. Hodí sa ku každému durovému aj molovému akordu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open 3, string 2 fret 2, string 1 fret 2, back to string 2.
rows.translation: Prázdna 3, struna 2 na pražci 2, struna 1 na pražci 2, späť na strunu 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Move it to a fretted root
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: From G on fret 3 of string 4, use your index finger for the root and your ring finger for the fifth and octave, both on fret 5.
rows.translation: Od G na pražci 3 struny 4 hrajte základný tón ukazovákom a kvintu aj oktávu prstenníkom, obe na pražci 5.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Index on the root, ring finger on fret 5 for the fifth and the octave.
rows.translation: Ukazovák na základnom tóne, prstenník na pražci 5 pre kvintu aj oktávu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: You slide the shape so the root is fret 3 of string 3. Which chord is it now?
rows.translation: Posuniete hmat tak, že základný tón je na pražci 3 struny 3. Ktorý akord teraz hráte?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Fret 3 of string 3 is C. Same shape, new root.
rows.translation: Pražec 3 na strune 3 je C. Rovnaký hmat, nový základný tón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Root on the beat, fifth and octave to fill the bar. Keep the root strong and the other notes even.
rows.translation: Základný tón na dobu, kvinta a oktáva vyplnia takt. Základný tón nech je výrazný a ostatné tóny rovnomerné.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: What is the fifth of E?
rows.translation: Ktorý tón je kvintou od E?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The 12-bar blues, walking lines and chromatic approach notes.
rows.translation: 12-taktové blues, kráčajúce linky a chromatické nástupné tóny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The blues repeats a 12-bar loop: four bars of A, two of D, two of A, then E, D, A, E. Count the bars and you always know where you are.
rows.translation: Blues opakuje 12-taktový sled: štyri takty A, dva D, dva A, potom E, D, A, E. Počítajte takty a vždy budete vedieť, kde ste.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: How many bars of A open the 12-bar blues?
rows.translation: Koľkými taktmi A sa začína 12-taktové blues?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Bars 9 to 12 go E, D, A, E. The E in bar 12 turns the loop around.
rows.translation: Takty 9 až 12 idú E, D, A, E. E v takte 12 vracia sled na začiatok.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A new note on every beat
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A walking bass line plays a new note on every beat. Start with root, third, fifth, sixth: over A that's A, C sharp, E, F sharp.
rows.translation: Kráčajúca basová linka hrá na každú dobu nový tón. Začnite základným tónom, terciou, kvintou a sextou: nad A sú to A, Cis, E, Fis.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open 3, fret 4; then string 2, frets 2 and 4.
rows.translation: Prázdna 3, pražec 4; potom struna 2 na pražcoch 2 a 4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: What makes a bass line walk?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open 2, fret 4; then string 1, frets 2 and 4.
rows.translation: Prázdna 2, pražec 4; potom struna 1 na pražcoch 2 a 4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: On beat 4, play a note one fret away from the next root. It pulls the ear forward, so the change feels like it arrives.
rows.translation: Na dobu 4 zahrajte tón o pražec vedľa nového základného tónu. Potiahne ucho dopredu a zmena bude pôsobiť ako príchod.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 3 fret 4, then open string 2: one fret up into D.
rows.translation: Struna 3 na pražci 4, potom prázdna struna 2: o pražec nahor do D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: You're heading to D in the next bar. Which note on beat 4 pulls best?
rows.translation: V ďalšom takte mierite k D. Ktorý tón na dobu 4 najlepšie povedie k nemu?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: C sharp is one fret below D. A half step slides right into the new root.
rows.translation: Cis je o pražec pod D. Poltón vás privedie priamo k novému základnému tónu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Kráčajúci bas v blues v A
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Put the walk on the form
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Same 12 bars, now with a walking line. Bars that lead into a new chord end on an approach note.
rows.translation: Rovnakých 12 taktov, teraz s kráčajúcou linkou. Takty vedúce k novému akordu končia nástupným tónom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Why does bar 12 end on G sharp?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: It leads back to A at the top
rows.translation: Vedie späť k A na začiatku
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Bar 12 turns the form around. G sharp sits one fret below A, the chord that starts the next time through.
rows.translation: Takt 12 vracia formu na začiatok. Gis leží o pražec pod A, akordom začínajúcim ďalšie opakovanie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Blues v A s kráčajúcim basom
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The 12-bar blues works in any key. In E the chords are E, A and B. Walk with roots, thirds, fifths and sixths, and approach each change.
rows.translation: 12-taktové blues funguje v každej tónine. V E sú akordy E, A a B. Kráčajte cez základné tóny, tercie, kvinty a sexty a pripravte každú zmenu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In the key of E, which chord comes in bar 9?
rows.translation: Ktorý akord v tónine E prichádza v takte 9?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: String 3 fret 2; string 2 frets 1 and 4; string 1 fret 1.
rows.translation: Struna 3, pražec 2; struna 2, pražce 1 a 4; struna 1, pražec 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Blues v E s kráčajúcim basom
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Eighth-note rock, dotted rhythms, space, and a Motown-style line.
rows.translation: Osminový rock, bodkované rytmy, priestor a linka v štýle Motown.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Count 1 and 2 and 3 and 4 and. Play a note on every count with your fingers taking turns. Even volume is the goal.
rows.translation: Počítajte 1 a 2 a 3 a 4 a. Na každé počítanie zahrajte tón a striedajte prsty. Cieľom je rovnomerná hlasitosť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Your eighth notes start to rush. What helps?
rows.translation: Vaše osminy začínajú zrýchľovať. Čo pomôže?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Lock to the click and relax your hand
rows.translation: Držať sa kliku a uvoľniť ruku
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A dotted quarter lasts one and a half beats. Play on 1, hold through 2, then play on the and of 2, then on 3 and 4.
rows.translation: Štvrťová nota s bodkou trvá jeden a pol doby. Zahrajte na 1, držte cez začiatok 2, potom zahrajte na „a“ doby 2, potom na 3 a 4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Long-short on A, D and E
rows.translation: Dlho-krátko na A, D a E
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: How long does a dotted quarter note last?
rows.translation: Ako dlho trvá štvrťová nota s bodkou?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Silence is part of the groove
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Short notes with clean rests make a line bounce. Ease off the fretting finger, still touching the string, to stop each note right on time.
rows.translation: Krátke tóny s čistými pomlčkami dodajú linke pružnosť. Uvoľnite tlak prsta na hmatníku, ale struny sa stále dotýkajte, aby každý tón skončil načas.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: How do you stop a fretted note cleanly?
rows.translation: Ako čisto zastavíte tón na pražci?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Ease off but keep touching it
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Release the pressure while your finger stays on the string. The note stops without a buzz.
rows.translation: Uvoľnite tlak a prst nechajte na strune. Tón skončí bez drnčania.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Busy, but always in the pocket
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Motown-era bass lines moved a lot: chord tones, notes that lean into the next chord, and pushes off the beat. This line is new, written in that spirit.
rows.translation: Basové linky éry Motown sa veľa pohybovali: akordové tóny, tóny smerujúce k ďalšiemu akordu a posuny mimo doby. Táto linka je nová, napísaná v tomto duchu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The first bar: C, E, G, then B flat leaning into A.
rows.translation: Prvý takt: C, E, G, potom znížené B smerujúce k A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: What does B flat do at the end of bar 1?
rows.translation: Čo robí znížené B na konci taktu 1?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Leads down a fret into A
rows.translation: Vedie o pražec nadol do A
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: It's an approach note, one fret above A, the root of the next chord. It slides you into the next bar.
rows.translation: Je to nástupný tón o pražec nad A, základným tónom nasledujúceho akordu. Privedie vás do ďalšieho taktu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Eighth notes, dotted rhythms and a moving line. Stay with the click, keep your fingers taking turns and enjoy the groove.
rows.translation: Osminové noty, bodkované rytmy a pohyblivá linka. Držte sa kliku, striedajte prsty a užívajte si rytmus.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In an eighth-note groove, which counts get a note?
rows.translation: Kedy zaznie tón v osminovom rytme?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Bow, finger and play in tune, from open strings to fiddle tunes
rows.translation: Od prázdnych strún po ľudové melódie: sláčik, prsty a čistá intonácia
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Hold it, bow it, tune it, play the open strings and your first song.
rows.translation: Uchopte husle, použite sláčik, nalaďte ich a zahrajte prázdne struny aj prvú pieseň.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Štyri struny od nízkej po vysokú
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: With the violin under your chin, the strings run G, D, A, E from left to right. G is the thickest and lowest. E is the thinnest and highest, and we call it string 1.
rows.translation: Keď máte husle pod bradou, struny idú zľava doprava G, D, A, E. G je najhrubšia a najnižšia. E je najtenšia a najvyššia a voláme ju struna 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The bridge is the thin wooden arch that holds the strings up. String pressure alone keeps it standing. If it starts to lean, ask a teacher or shop to set it straight.
rows.translation: Kobylka je tenký drevený oblúk, ktorý podopiera struny. Drží ju iba tlak strún. Ak sa začne nakláňať, požiadajte učiteľa alebo servis, aby ju narovnal.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: E is the thinnest string and the highest. Strings count from E (1) to G (4).
rows.translation: E je najtenšia a najvyššia struna. Struny sa počítajú od E (1) po G (4).
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Before you use the bow, pluck. Rest your right thumb against the side of the fingerboard and pull the string with your first finger. Players call this pizzicato.
rows.translation: Pred použitím sláčika brnkajte. Pravý palec oprite o bok hmatníka a ukazovákom potiahnite strunu. Hráči to volajú pizzicato.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Rest the violin on your lap like a small guitar. Pluck string 2, the A, and let it ring.
rows.translation: Položte husle na kolená ako malú gitaru. Brnknite na strunu 2, A, a nechajte ju znieť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Now the thickest string, the G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Set the violin's lower edge on your left collarbone and turn your head to rest your jaw on the chin rest. The weight of your head holds it. No clamping.
rows.translation: Spodný okraj huslí položte na ľavú kľúčnu kosť a otočte hlavu tak, aby sánka spočinula na podbradníku. Drží ich váha hlavy. Nezvierajte ich.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Point the scroll forward and to your left, about level with the floor. Your left hand cradles the neck, thumb across from your first finger. Keep the wrist straight and soft.
rows.translation: Hlavicu nasmerujte dopredu doľava, približne rovnobežne s podlahou. Ľavá ruka podopiera krk, palec oproti ukazováku. Zápästie držte rovné a uvoľnené.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Your collarbone and the weight of your head
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Let your head rest on the chin rest. A squeezing hand or a raised shoulder makes you tense, and tension pulls notes out of tune.
rows.translation: Hlavu nechajte spočívať na podbradníku. Zovretá ruka alebo zdvihnuté rameno vytvára napätie a to zhoršuje intonáciu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Hold the violin in place and pluck the D string, string 3.
rows.translation: Držte husle v polohe a brnknite na strunu D, strunu 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The wooden stick runs from the frog, where you hold it, to the tip. Horsehair stretches between them. Tighten the screw until a pencil just fits between hair and stick.
rows.translation: Drevený prút vedie od žabky, pri ktorej ho držíte, po špičku. Medzi nimi je napnuté konské vlásie. Skrutku utiahnite tak, aby sa medzi vlásie a prút práve zmestila ceruzka.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Bend your thumb and set its tip where the frog meets the stick. Drape your fingers over the stick, with your little finger standing curved on top. Keep the whole hand soft.
rows.translation: Palec ohnite a jeho konček položte tam, kde sa žabka stretáva s prútom. Prsty voľne preložte cez prút; ohnutý malíček stojí zhora na prúte. Celú ruku nechajte mäkkú.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Bent, where the frog meets the stick
rows.translation: Ohnutý na styku žabky a prúta
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Flat on top of the stick
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A bent thumb at the frog lets the hand stay soft and balance the bow.
rows.translation: Ohnutý palec pri žabke udrží ruku uvoľnenú a pomáha vyvažovať sláčik.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Bare hair slides over the string without a sound. Rub the cake of rosin along the hair a few times before you play. A light coat is enough.
rows.translation: Holé vlásie sa po strune šmýka bez zvuku. Pred hrou niekoľkokrát prejdite kúskom kolofónie po vlásí. Stačí tenká vrstva.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Set the bow on the A string, halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Pull it slowly to the right.
rows.translation: Sláčik položte na strunu A v polovici medzi kobylkou a hmatníkom. Pomaly ťahajte doprava.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Now the D string. Lift your elbow a little, then pull slowly.
rows.translation: Teraz struna D. Trochu zdvihnite lakeť a potom pomaly ťahajte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: From low to high: G, D, A, E. Each string is five letter names above the last, an interval called a fifth. Try: Good Dogs Always Eat.
rows.translation: Od nízkej po vysokú: G, D, A, E. Každá struna je o kvintu vyššie, teda päť názvov tónov pri počítaní od prvého vrátane. Pomôcka: Gorila Dnes Asi Experimentuje.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Your right elbow sets which string the bow plays. Raise it for G, lower it for E. Each string has its own level, like the steps of a stair.
rows.translation: Pravý lakeť určuje, na ktorej strune hrá sláčik. Pre G ho zdvihnite, pre E spustite. Každá struna má vlastnú výšku ruky ako schody.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Bow the G string, then D. Your elbow is highest for G.
rows.translation: Zahrajte sláčikom strunu G a potom D. Pri G je lakeť najvyššie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Now A, then E. Lower your elbow one step for each.
rows.translation: Teraz A, potom E. Pri každej spustite lakeť o jeden stupeň.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which string needs the highest elbow?
rows.translation: Pri ktorej strune je lakeť najvyššie?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The G string sits farthest to the left, so your arm lifts to reach it. E needs the lowest arm.
rows.translation: Struna G je najďalej vľavo, preto k nej ruku zdvíhate. Pri E je ruka najnižšie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Orchestras tune to A. Timbre shows how far each string is from its note in cents; 100 cents make a half step, the smallest step on a piano. Tune A, then D, G and E.
rows.translation: Orchestre ladia podľa A. Timbre ukazuje odchýlku struny od jej tónu v centoch; 100 centov tvorí poltón, najmenší krok na klavíri. Nalaďte A, potom D, G a E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
