rows.source: The small screws on the tailpiece are fine tuners. Turn one clockwise to raise the pitch, counterclockwise to lower it. Quarter turns are plenty.
rows.translation: Malé skrutky na strunníku sú jemné dolaďovače. Otáčaním v smere hodinových ručičiek tón zvýšite, proti smeru znížite. Stačí štvrť otáčky.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A string is a little flat. What do you do?
rows.translation: Struna znie trochu nízko. Čo urobíte?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Flat means too low. Clockwise tightens the string and raises the pitch.
rows.translation: Podladený tón je príliš nízky. Otáčanie v smere hodinových ručičiek strunu napína a tón zvyšuje.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: If a fine tuner runs out of room, use the peg. Turn it a little while pushing it inward so it holds. If a string is far off, ask a teacher; pegs can slip.
rows.translation: Ak jemnému dolaďovaču dôjde rozsah, použite kolík. Trochu ním otočte a zároveň ho zatláčajte dovnútra, aby držal. Pri veľkej odchýlke požiadajte učiteľa; kolíky sa môžu uvoľniť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Tune your A string, then bow it and hold it steady.
rows.translation: Nalaďte strunu A, potom ju rozozvučte sláčikom a držte rovnomerný tón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Now D, G and E. Tune each one, then bow it and hold it.
rows.translation: Teraz D, G a E. Každú nalaďte, potom zahrajte sláčikom a podržte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Violin on your collarbone, soft bow hold, bow halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Now play everything from this unit.
rows.translation: Husle na kľúčnej kosti, mäkké držanie sláčika a sláčik v polovici medzi kobylkou a hmatníkom. Teraz zahrajte všetko z tejto jednotky.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Bow each open string from high to low. Hold each one steady.
rows.translation: Zahrajte sláčikom každú prázdnu strunu od vysokej po nízku. Každý tón držte rovnomerne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which string do you tune first?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Orchestras tune to A, so start there and tune the others after it.
rows.translation: Orchestre ladia podľa A, preto začnite ním a potom nalaďte ostatné.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the A string: open A, first finger a whole step up for B, second finger another whole step up for C sharp. Pluck it first, then bow it.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb hráte na strune A: prázdne A, prvý prst o celý tón vyššie na B, druhý prst o ďalší celý tón vyššie na Cis. Najprv brnkajte, potom hrajte sláčikom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: First finger on the A string, a whole step up. That's B.
rows.translation: Prvý prst na strune A o celý tón vyššie. To je B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Second finger a whole step above your first. That's C sharp.
rows.translation: Druhý prst o celý tón nad prvým. To je Cis.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: C sharp, B, A, B, then C sharp three times.
rows.translation: Cis, B, A, B, potom trikrát Cis.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Long, even bows, clean string crossings and your first rhythms.
rows.translation: Dlhé rovnomerné ťahy, čisté prechody medzi strunami a prvé rytmy.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Ťah od žabky a k žabke
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A down-bow pulls the bow to the right, from frog to tip. An up-bow pushes it back to the left. In music, a down-bow mark looks like a little table and an up-bow like a V.
rows.translation: Ťah od žabky vedie sláčik doprava, od žabky ku špičke. Ťah k žabke ho vracia doľava. Značka pre ťah od žabky vyzerá ako malý stolík, pre opačný smer ako V.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which way does a down-bow move?
rows.translation: Ktorým smerom ide ťah od žabky?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Play halfway between the bridge and the end of the fingerboard. Keep the bow parallel to the bridge, like a train on its track.
rows.translation: Hrajte v polovici medzi kobylkou a koncom hmatníka. Sláčik držte rovnobežne s kobylkou ako vlak na koľajnici.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: One slow down-bow, then one slow up-bow on A. Keep the sound even to the end.
rows.translation: Jeden pomalý ťah od žabky, potom jeden k žabke na A. Zvuk držte rovnomerný až do konca.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A quarter note lasts one beat. Quick notes need less bow, so use the middle half of the bow and keep every stroke the same length.
rows.translation: Štvrťová nota trvá jednu dobu. Rýchle tóny potrebujú menej sláčika, preto používajte jeho strednú polovicu a každý ťah rovnakej dĺžky.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Štvrťové noty na A a D
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A half note lasts two beats. Use a longer, slower bow so the sound doesn't fade on the second beat.
rows.translation: Polová nota trvá dve doby. Použite dlhší a pomalší ťah, aby zvuk na druhej dobe neslabol.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A half note lasts twice as long, so it gets a longer, slower stroke.
rows.translation: Polová nota trvá dvakrát tak dlho, preto dostane dlhší a pomalší ťah.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: To cross strings, change levels with your elbow, not your wrist. Arrive at the new level just before the bow changes direction.
rows.translation: Pri prechode medzi strunami meňte výšku lakťom, nie zápästím. Do novej výšky sa dostaňte tesne pred zmenou smeru sláčika.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A, E, A, E. Let your elbow rock between the two levels.
rows.translation: A, E, A, E. Lakeť nech sa kolíše medzi dvoma výškami.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: What moves the bow to a new string?
rows.translation: Čo presúva sláčik na novú strunu?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Going from G to A skips the D string, so your elbow makes a bigger move. Travel smoothly and don't let the middle string sound.
rows.translation: Pri prechode z G na A preskočíte D, preto lakeť urobí väčší pohyb. Prejdite plynulo a prostrednú strunu nerozozvučte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: An eighth note lasts half a beat, so two fit in each beat. Use small, quick bows near the middle of the bow.
rows.translation: Osminová nota trvá polovicu doby, preto sa do jednej zmestia dve. Používajte malé rýchle ťahy pri strede sláčika.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: How many eighth notes fit in one beat?
rows.translation: Koľko osminových nôt sa zmestí do jednej doby?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Now mix them: a quarter, two eighths, then two quarters. Fiddlers lean on this rhythm. Say it first: long, short-short, long, long.
rows.translation: Teraz ich zmiešajte: štvrťová, dve osminy, potom dve štvrťové. Ľudoví huslisti sa o tento rytmus opierajú. Najprv ho vyslovte: dlho, krátko-krátko, dlho, dlho.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Straight bows at the contact point, crossings led by the elbow, and steady rhythms. Here's a mix of all three.
rows.translation: Rovné ťahy v správnom mieste kontaktu, prechody vedené lakťom a rovnomerné rytmy. Tu je zmes všetkých troch.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: V polovici medzi kobylkou a hmatníkom
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Right on top of the bridge
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Over the end of the fingerboard
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Place fingers 1, 2 and 3, play the A major scale and your first song.
rows.translation: Položte prsty 1, 2 a 3, zahrajte stupnicu A dur a prvú pieseň.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Your instrument has no frets, so your ear places every note. Many players stick thin tapes on the fingerboard as a guide while they learn.
rows.translation: Váš nástroj nemá pražce, preto každý tón umiestňuje sluch. Mnohí začiatočníci si na hmatník nalepia tenké pásiky ako pomôcku.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Put your first fingertip on the A string at the first tape. That's B, a whole step above A; a whole step is two half steps. Press until the string meets the fingerboard.
rows.translation: Konček prvého prsta položte na strunu A pri prvej páske. To je B, o celý tón nad A; celý tón tvoria dva poltóny. Pritlačte strunu k hmatníku.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open A, then B with your first finger. Hold B until it settles in tune.
rows.translation: Prázdne A, potom B prvým prstom. B držte, kým nebude čisté.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Timbre accepts a note within 30 cents, about a third of a half step. If you're sharp, nudge the finger toward the scroll. If you're flat, nudge it toward the bridge.
rows.translation: Timbre prijme tón s odchýlkou do 30 centov, asi tretiny poltónu. Ak znie vysoko, posuňte prst k hlavici. Ak nízko, posuňte ho ku kobylke.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: B, open A, B. Lift the finger and set it down in the same spot.
rows.translation: B, prázdne A, B. Zdvihnite prst a položte ho na rovnaké miesto.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open A, then B. How far apart?
rows.translation: Prázdne A, potom B. Aká je vzdialenosť?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Second finger plays C sharp, a whole step above B, so leave a gap after first finger. This spot is called high 2, because it sits close to where third finger will go.
rows.translation: Druhý prst hrá Cis, o celý tón nad B, preto po prvom prste nechajte medzeru. Táto poloha prsta sa volá vysoký prst 2, lebo je blízko budúceho miesta tretieho prsta.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A, B, C sharp. Keep first finger down while second plays.
rows.translation: A, B, Cis. Keď hrá druhý prst, prvý nechajte položený.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: From B to the next note: what kind of step?
rows.translation: Aký krok je z B na ďalší tón?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: How far is C sharp above B?
rows.translation: Ako vysoko nad B je Cis?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: B to C sharp is two half steps, so second finger leaves a gap after first.
rows.translation: Od B po Cis sú dva poltóny, preto druhý prst necháva medzeru po prvom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: B, C sharp, B, A. Land each note in tune before you move on.
rows.translation: B, Cis, B, A. Každý tón zahrajte čisto, až potom pokračujte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Third finger plays D, a half step above C sharp, so it sits right against second finger. On the A string the pattern is 1, then 2 and 3 together.
rows.translation: Tretí prst hrá D, o poltón nad Cis, preto leží tesne pri druhom. Na strune A je vzor 1 a potom 2 a 3 spolu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A, B, C sharp, D. Leave each finger down as you add the next.
rows.translation: A, B, Cis, D. Pri pridávaní ďalšieho prsta nechajte predchádzajúce položené.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: When your D is in tune, the open D string vibrates along with it. The two share a letter name, eight notes apart: an octave. Listen for the violin sounding fuller.
rows.translation: Keď je vaše D čisté, prázdna struna D sa rozvibruje spolu s ním. Majú rovnaký názov a pri počítaní vrátane krajov ich delí osem tónov: oktáva. Počúvajte plnší zvuk huslí.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Third-finger D, open D, then third-finger D again. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: D tretím prstom, prázdne D, znova D tretím prstom. Počúvajte súzvuk.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which fingers touch on the A string?
rows.translation: Ktoré prsty sa na strune A dotýkajú?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: B to C sharp is a whole step, so 1 and 2 have a gap. C sharp to D is a half step, so 2 and 3 touch.
rows.translation: Od B po Cis je celý tón, preto medzi 1 a 2 zostáva medzera. Od Cis po D je poltón, preto sa 2 a 3 dotýkajú.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: On the E string, first finger plays F sharp, high second G sharp, and third A. It's the A-string shape, one string higher. Lower your bow arm to the E level.
rows.translation: Na strune E hrá prvý prst Fis, vysoký druhý Gis a tretí A. Je to prstoklad struny A o jednu strunu vyššie. Ruku so sláčikom spustite do výšky E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: E, F sharp, G sharp, A. Same shape as on the A string.
rows.translation: E, Fis, Gis, A. Rovnaký prstoklad ako na strune A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Your third finger on E plays A. What can you check it against?
rows.translation: Tretí prst na E hrá A. S čím ho môžete porovnať?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The open A string is an octave below, so it rings along when your A is in tune.
rows.translation: Prázdna struna A je o oktávu nižšie, preto sa rozozvučí spolu s vaším čistým A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Join the halves: A, B, C sharp, D on the A string, then E, F sharp, G sharp, A on the E string. Eight notes, A to A, one shape played twice.
rows.translation: Spojte polovice: A, B, Cis, D na strune A, potom E, Fis, Gis, A na strune E. Osem tónov od A po A, jeden prstoklad zahraný dvakrát.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Up the A major scale, slowly. Cross to E for the top four notes.
rows.translation: Pomaly nahor po A dur. Na štyri vrchné tóny prejdite na E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: This French melody from the 1700s uses only notes you've learned: A, B, C sharp, D on the A string, and E and F sharp on the E string.
rows.translation: Táto francúzska melódia zo storočia začínajúceho rokom 1700 používa iba naučené tóny: A, B, Cis, D na strune A a E aj Fis na strune E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which finger plays F sharp on the E string?
rows.translation: Ktorým prstom hráte Fis na strune E?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Whole step, whole step, half step: that's the pattern on A and E. Land each note in tune and let the open strings ring with you.
rows.translation: Celý tón, celý tón, poltón: to je vzor na A aj E. Každý tón zahrajte čisto a nechajte prázdne struny rezonovať spolu s vami.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Second finger to third: what kind of step?
rows.translation: Od druhého po tretí prst: aký krok?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: B, C sharp, D, then open D. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: B, Cis, D, potom prázdne D. Počúvajte súzvuk.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which note does high 2 play on the E string?
rows.translation: Ktorý tón hrá vysoký prst 2 na strune E?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: F sharp, G sharp, A on the E string, then open A an octave lower.
rows.translation: Fis, Gis, A na strune E, potom prázdne A o oktávu nižšie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The same finger pattern on two lower strings, D major and three tunes.
rows.translation: Rovnaký prstoklad na dvoch nižších strunách, D dur a tri melódie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: On the D string, first finger plays E, high second F sharp, and third G. It's the A-string pattern, one string lower. Raise your bow arm a step.
rows.translation: Na strune D hrá prvý prst E, vysoký druhý Fis a tretí G. Je to vzor struny A o jednu strunu nižšie. Ruku so sláčikom zdvihnite o jeden stupeň.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D, E, F sharp, G. Second and third fingers touch.
rows.translation: D, E, Fis, G. Druhý a tretí prst sa dotýkajú.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Third-finger G on the D string is an octave above the open G string. When it's in tune, the G string hums along.
rows.translation: G tretím prstom na strune D je o oktávu nad prázdnou strunou G. Keď je čisté, struna G rezonuje spolu s ním.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Third-finger G, open G, third-finger G. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: G tretím prstom, prázdne G, G tretím prstom. Počúvajte súzvuk.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: On the D string, which fingers touch?
rows.translation: Ktoré prsty sa na strune D dotýkajú?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: It's the A-string pattern again: whole step, whole step, half step. The half step is between 2 and 3.
rows.translation: Opäť vzor struny A: celý tón, celý tón, poltón. Poltón je medzi 2 a 3.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Play D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, then A, B, C sharp, D on the A string. The D major scale is one finger shape played twice.
rows.translation: Na strune D zahrajte D, E, Fis, G, potom na strune A A, B, Cis, D. Stupnica D dur je jeden prstoklad zahraný dvakrát.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Up the D major scale. Cross to the A string on the fifth note.
rows.translation: Nahor po D dur. Pri piatom tóne prejdite na strunu A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which notes are sharp in D major?
rows.translation: Ktoré tóny majú v D dur krížik?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D major has two sharps, F sharp and C sharp. Both are high 2.
rows.translation: D dur má dva krížiky, Fis a Cis. Oba hrá vysoký prst 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Proper title identifying an external traditional fiddle/teaching tune: Lightly Row. Reviewer should assess established Slovak naming; not an exemption for generic instructions. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: Lightly Row is an old German children's song. It walks up and down the D major scale on the D and A strings.
rows.translation: Lightly Row je stará nemecká detská pieseň. Postupuje nahor a nadol po D dur na strunách D a A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which finger plays the F sharps?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: First finger on the A string
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Third finger on the D string
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: On the G string, first finger plays A, high second B, and third C. Same shape again. Raise your bow arm to its highest level.
rows.translation: Na strune G hrá prvý prst A, vysoký druhý B a tretí C. Opäť rovnaký prstoklad. Ruku so sláčikom zdvihnite do najvyššej výšky.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G, A, B, C. Swing your left elbow a little under the violin to reach.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C. Ľavý lakeť posuňte trochu pod husle, aby ste dočiahli.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: First-finger A on the G string, then the open A string. Same letter, an octave apart.
rows.translation: A prvým prstom na strune G, potom prázdna struna A. Rovnaký názov, odstup oktávy.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G, A, B, C on the G string plus D, E, F sharp, G on the D string make G major. It's the first octave of a two-octave scale you'll finish in the next unit.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C na strune G spolu s D, E, Fis, G na strune D tvoria G dur. Je to prvá oktáva dvojoktávovej stupnice, ktorú dokončíte v ďalšej jednotke.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Up the G major scale. Same shape on both strings.
rows.translation: Nahor po G dur. Rovnaký prstoklad na oboch strunách.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Beethoven wrote this tune for his Ninth Symphony in 1824. It moves mostly by step, so your fingers walk.
rows.translation: Beethoven napísal túto melódiu pre svoju Deviatu symfóniu v roku 1824. Väčšinou postupuje po krokoch, takže prsty kráčajú.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Each line ends long, short, long: a dotted quarter, an eighth and a half note. A dot after a note adds half its length.
rows.translation: Každý riadok končí dlho, krátko, dlho: štvrťová nota s bodkou, osminová a polová. Bodka pridáva polovicu dĺžky noty.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Proper title identifying an external traditional fiddle/teaching tune: Boil Them Cabbage Down. Reviewer should assess established Slovak naming; not an exemption for generic instructions. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: This old American fiddle tune rides the rhythm you bowed on open strings: long, short-short, long, long. Fiddlers play it at jams everywhere.
rows.translation: Táto stará americká husľová melódia používa rytmus z prázdnych strún: dlho, krátko-krátko, dlho, dlho. Huslisti ju hrajú na spoločných jamoch všade.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which string does this tune never use?
rows.translation: Ktorú strunu táto melódia vôbec nepoužíva?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: It lives on the D, A and E strings.
rows.translation: Hrá sa na strunách D, A a E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Whole step, whole step, half step works on every string so far. Raise your bow arm for the low strings and let the octaves ring.
rows.translation: Celý tón, celý tón, poltón zatiaľ funguje na každej strune. Pre nízke struny zdvihnite ruku so sláčikom a nechajte oktávy znieť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Two octave checks: G with open G, then A with open A.
rows.translation: Dve oktávové kontroly: G s prázdnym G, potom A s prázdnym A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In D major, which finger plays C sharp?
rows.translation: Ktorým prstom hráte Cis v D dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Move second finger to change keys: G major in two octaves, A minor and fiddle tunes.
rows.translation: Posunom druhého prsta meňte tóniny: G dur v dvoch oktávach, A mol a ľudové husľové melódie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Slide second finger back until it touches first. On the A string that's C natural, a half step below C sharp. Players call it low 2.
rows.translation: Druhý prst posuňte späť, až sa dotkne prvého. Na strune A je to C bez posuvky, o poltón pod Cis. Hráči to volajú nízky prst 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A, B, C, D. Second finger touches first; leave a gap before third.
rows.translation: A, B, C, D. Druhý prst sa dotýka prvého; pred tretím nechajte medzeru.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: B, potom vysoký prst 2 alebo nízky prst 2?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: High 2, low 2, high 2, low 2. Move only your second finger.
rows.translation: Vysoký prst 2, nízky prst 2, vysoký prst 2, nízky prst 2. Pohybujte iba druhým prstom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G major needs C natural on the A string and G natural on the E string, so second finger sits low there. On the G and D strings it stays high.
rows.translation: G dur potrebuje C bez posuvky na strune A a G bez posuvky na strune E, preto je tam druhý prst nízko. Na strunách G a D zostáva vysoko.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The A string in G major: second finger low, touching first.
rows.translation: Struna A v G dur: druhý prst nízko pri prvom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Now E, F sharp, G on the E string. Low 2 again.
rows.translation: Teraz E, Fis, G na strune E. Opäť nízky prst 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Where does second finger go on the E string in G major?
rows.translation: Kam patrí druhý prst na strune E v G dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G natural is a half step above F sharp, so second finger tucks right against first.
rows.translation: G bez posuvky je o poltón nad Fis, preto sa druhý prst pritúli k prvému.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Start on open G and climb to G on the E string: fifteen notes, two octaves. High 2 on the low strings, low 2 on the high ones.
rows.translation: Začnite prázdnym G a stúpajte po G na strune E: pätnásť tónov, dve oktávy. Vysoký prst 2 na nízkych strunách, nízky prst 2 na vysokých.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A minor starts with first-finger A on the G string. Second finger is high on the G string for B, then low on the D string for F natural.
rows.translation: A mol začína tónom A prvým prstom na strune G. Druhý prst je na strune G vysoko pre B a na strune D nízko pre F bez posuvky.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A minor, up. High 2 on the G string, low 2 on the D string.
rows.translation: A mol nahor. Vysoký prst 2 na strune G, nízky prst 2 na strune D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Čo dáva tejto stupnici molový charakter?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Its third note is a half step lower
rows.translation: Tretí tón je o poltón nižšie
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: It starts on a lower string
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A to C sounds dark; A to C sharp sounds bright. One half step changes the whole mood.
rows.translation: A až C znie temne, A až Cis jasne. Jeden poltón zmení celú náladu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: This minuet comes from the notebook Bach gave his wife Anna Magdalena in 1725. It's now credited to Christian Petzold. Count three beats to a bar.
rows.translation: Tento menuet je zo zošita, ktorý Bach daroval manželke Anne Magdalene v roku 1725. Dnes sa jeho autorstvo pripisuje Christianovi Petzoldovi. Počítajte tri doby v takte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which C does the minuet use?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The minuet is in G major, so C is natural and second finger sits low on the A string.
rows.translation: Menuet je v G dur, preto C nemá posuvku a druhý prst je na strune A nízko.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: F sharp is high 2 on the D string: low on A, high on D.
rows.translation: Fis hrá vysoký prst 2 na strune D: nízko na A, vysoko na D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The second half starts high: fourth finger reaches B on the E string. Then third, then low 2.
rows.translation: Druhá polovica začína vysoko: štvrtý prst dočiahne na B na strune E. Potom tretí a nízky prst 2.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Proper title identifying an external traditional fiddle/teaching tune: Old Joe Clark. Reviewer should assess established Slovak naming; not an exemption for generic instructions. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.translation: Vysoký prst 2 a nízky prst 2 spolu
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Old Joe Clark is an Appalachian fiddle tune. It's in A but uses G natural: high 2 for C sharp on the A string, low 2 for G on the E string.
rows.translation: Old Joe Clark je apalačská husľová melódia. Je v A, ale používa G bez posuvky: vysoký prst 2 pre Cis na strune A a nízky prst 2 pre G na strune E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: E, F sharp, G, F sharp. Keep second finger low, touching first.
rows.translation: E, Fis, G, Fis. Druhý prst držte nízko pri prvom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which G does this tune use on the E string?
rows.translation: Ktoré G používa táto melódia na strune E?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G natural instead of G sharp gives Old Joe Clark its old-time sound.
rows.translation: G bez posuvky namiesto Gis dáva Old Joe Clark tradičný starobylý zvuk.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Proper title identifying an external traditional fiddle/teaching tune: Soldier's Joy. Reviewer should assess established Slovak naming; not an exemption for generic instructions. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: Soldier's Joy was printed in Scotland in the 1700s and is still played at dances across America. Its first part rocks on A, F sharp and D, the notes of a D major chord.
rows.translation: Soldier's Joy vyšla v Škótsku v storočí začínajúcom rokom 1700 a dodnes sa hrá na tanečných zábavách po Amerike. Prvá časť sa kolíše na A, Fis a D, tónoch akordu D dur.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open A, high-2 F sharp on D, open D, F sharp. Rock your elbow between strings.
rows.translation: Prázdne A, Fis vysokým prstom 2 na D, prázdne D, Fis. Lakeť kolíšte medzi strunami.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which finger plays G on the E string?
rows.translation: Ktorým prstom hráte G na strune E?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Soldier's Joy is in D major, so G is natural: high 2 for F sharp on D, low 2 for G on E.
rows.translation: Soldier's Joy je v D dur, preto je G bez posuvky: vysoký prst 2 pre Fis na D, nízky prst 2 pre G na E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Every key sets your second finger. Before you play, ask: high 2 or low 2, and on which string?
rows.translation: Každá tónina určuje miesto druhého prsta. Pred hrou sa spýtajte: vysoký prst 2 alebo nízky prst 2 a na ktorej strune?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: F sharp, then high 2 or low 2?
rows.translation: Fis, potom vysoký prst 2 alebo nízky prst 2?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Low 2 and high 2 on the A string, then low 2 and high 2 on the E string.
rows.translation: Nízky prst 2 a vysoký prst 2 na strune A, potom nízky prst 2 a vysoký prst 2 na strune E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In A major, where does second finger sit on the A and E strings?
rows.translation: Kde je druhý prst na strunách A a E v A dur?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Low on A, high on E
rows.translation: Nízko na A, vysoko na E
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Loud and soft, slurs, your fourth finger, a first step toward vibrato, and Ode to Joy complete.
rows.translation: Hlasno a ticho, legato jedným ťahom, štvrtý prst, prvý krok k vibratu a celá Óda na radosť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Add arm weight, use more bow speed, and move the contact point closer to the bridge. Use all three together. For soft, do the opposite.
rows.translation: Pridajte váhu ruky, zrýchlite sláčik a posuňte miesto kontaktu bližšie ku kobylke. Použite všetky tri spolu. Pri tichej hre urobte opak.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Music marks loud with f, for forte, and soft with p, for piano. Growing louder is a crescendo; fading away is a diminuendo.
rows.translation: Hlasnú hru označuje f, teda forte, a tichú p, teda piano. Postupné zosilňovanie je crescendo, zoslabovanie diminuendo.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: To play forte, where does the bow move?
rows.translation: Kam posuniete sláčik pri hre forte?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Near the bridge the string takes more weight and speed, so it sounds louder without scratching.
rows.translation: Pri kobylke struna znesie väčšiu váhu a rýchlosť sláčika, preto znie hlasnejšie bez škrípania.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Each note twice: forte, then piano. Stay in tune while the volume changes.
rows.translation: Každý tón dvakrát: forte, potom piano. Pri zmene hlasitosti držte čistú intonáciu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Lightly Row, ticho a potom hlasno
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A curved line over notes is a slur: play them all in one bow. Your left hand changes notes while the bow keeps moving.
rows.translation: Oblúčik nad notami označuje legato: zahrajte ich jedným ťahom sláčika. Ľavá ruka mení tóny, kým sa sláčik neprestáva pohybovať.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Slur A to B in one down-bow, then B to A in one up-bow.
rows.translation: Spojte A s B jedným ťahom od žabky a potom B s A jedným ťahom k žabke.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Two notes in one bow means each gets half of it. Plan ahead and start a slur with enough bow left for both notes.
rows.translation: Dva tóny jedným ťahom znamenajú polovicu sláčika pre každý. Plánujte dopredu a legato začnite s dostatkom sláčika pre oba tóny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: What does a slur tell you?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Play the notes in one bow
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Fourth finger reaches a whole step above third. On the D string that's A, the same note as the open A string. Keep the finger curved and let your hand lean toward it.
rows.translation: Štvrtý prst dočiahne o celý tón nad tretí. Na strune D je to A, rovnaký tón ako prázdna struna A. Prst držte ohnutý a ruku k nemu mierne nakloňte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Fourth-finger A on the D string, open A, then fourth finger again. Match them exactly.
rows.translation: A štvrtým prstom na strune D, prázdne A a znova štvrtý prst. Tóny presne zlaďte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Why use fourth finger instead of an open string?
rows.translation: Prečo použiť štvrtý prst namiesto prázdnej struny?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: It avoids a string crossing and sounds warmer
rows.translation: Vyhne sa prechodu struny a znie teplejšie
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open strings are out of tune
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A fingered note keeps the line on one string and blends with the notes around it. Open strings ring brighter.
rows.translation: Tón hraný prstom udrží melódiu na jednej strune a spojí sa s okolitými tónmi. Prázdne struny znejú jasnejšie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Third-finger D, fourth-finger E on the A string, then open E. Listen for the match.
rows.translation: D tretím prstom, E štvrtým na strune A, potom prázdne E. Počúvajte zhodu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D to A on one string
rows.translation: Od D po A na jednej strune
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Amazing Grace is sung to an early American tune called New Britain. Its pairs of quick notes are slurs. Let the long notes sing with full, slow bows.
rows.translation: Amazing Grace sa spieva na starú americkú melódiu New Britain. Dvojice rýchlych tónov sa hrajú legato. Dlhé tóny nechajte spievať celým pomalým sláčikom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G to B and back crosses strings. Rock smoothly from the elbow.
rows.translation: Z G na B a späť prechádzate medzi strunami. Plynulo sa kolíšte lakťom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: How do you bow a quick pair, like B to G?
rows.translation: Ako zahráte sláčikom rýchlu dvojicu, napríklad B a G?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: They're slurred, so they share one bow.
rows.translation: Sú spojené legatom, preto majú spoločný ťah.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Vibrato is a small, even wave in pitch that makes long notes glow. The fingertip rolls slightly back from the note and returns, again and again, moved by the hand and arm.
rows.translation: Vibrato je malé rovnomerné vlnenie výšky, ktoré rozžiari dlhé tóny. Konček prsta sa pohybom ruky a paže mierne odvaľuje dozadu od tónu a vracia sa, stále dookola.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Vibrato can't rescue a note that's out of tune; it only colors one that's centered. Most players add it once their fingers land in tune without searching.
rows.translation: Vibrato nezachráni falošný tón, iba zafarbí správne umiestnený. Väčšina hráčov ho pridá, až keď prsty trafia čisté tóny bez hľadania.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: When is a note ready for vibrato?
rows.translation: Kedy je tón pripravený na vibrato?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Set second finger on the A string. Keep the fingertip in place, soften the knuckle, and slowly rock your hand toward the scroll and back. Small and even. A teacher's eye helps here.
rows.translation: Druhý prst položte na strunu A. Konček nechajte na mieste, uvoľnite kĺb a pomaly kolíšte rukou k hlavici a späť. Malé a rovnomerné pohyby. Tu pomôže dohľad učiteľa.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Now bow these without vibrato and center each one. That center is where vibrato starts.
rows.translation: Teraz hrajte sláčikom bez vibrata a každý tón presne dolaďte. Z tohto stredu sa vibrato začína.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Proper title of the external American fiddle tune; candidate for reviewer assessment of established Slovak naming. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: Arkansas Traveler was in print by 1847. Fiddlers slur its quickest notes in pairs, which gives the tune its skip. Start slow and keep the pairs even.
rows.translation: Arkansas Traveler vyšiel tlačou najneskôr v roku 1847. Huslisti spájajú najrýchlejšie tóny do dvojíc legato, čím melódia získava ľahkosť. Začnite pomaly a dvojice hrajte rovnomerne.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Why do fiddlers slur quick pairs?
rows.translation: Prečo huslisti spájajú rýchle dvojice legatom?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: It saves bow and adds a lilt
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: It keeps the strings in tune
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A, G, F sharp, A on the E string: third finger, low 2, first, third.
rows.translation: A, G, Fis, A na strune E: tretí prst, nízky prst 2, prvý, tretí.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Put it all together: in-tune fingers, straight bows, slurs and dynamics. Start piano, grow through the middle, and finish forte.
rows.translation: Spojte všetko: čistú intonáciu, rovné ťahy, legato a dynamiku. Začnite piano, v strede zosilnite a skončite forte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Warm up: fourth finger against the open strings, A and then E.
rows.translation: Rozohriatie: štvrtý prst porovnajte s prázdnymi strunami, najprv A a potom E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Complete conventional Italian dynamic marking Crescendo used in Slovak musical terminology; adjacent prose explains the meaning. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Complete conventional Italian dynamic marking Diminuendo used in Slovak musical terminology; adjacent prose explains the meaning. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Complete conventional Italian dynamic marking Piano used in Slovak musical terminology; adjacent prose explains the meaning. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: Sit, bow and play in tune, from open strings to The Swan
rows.translation: Seďte, hrajte sláčikom a čisto intonujte: od prázdnych strún po Labuť
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Sit, set the endpin, hold the bow, play the open strings and your first song.
rows.translation: Sadnite si, nastavte bodec, uchopte sláčik a zahrajte prázdne struny aj prvú pieseň.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: From low to high the strings are C, G, D and A. C is the thickest and lowest. A is the thinnest and highest, and we call it string 1.
rows.translation: Od nízkej po vysokú sú struny C, G, D a A. C je najhrubšia a najnižšia. A je najtenšia a najvyššia a voláme ju struna 1.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: C is the thickest string and the lowest. Strings count from A (1) to C (4).
rows.translation: C je najhrubšia a najnižšia struna. Struny sa počítajú od A (1) po C (4).
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Pluck string 1, the A, and let it ring.
rows.translation: Brnknite na strunu 1, A, a nechajte ju znieť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Now the thickest string, the C. Let it rumble.
rows.translation: Teraz najhrubšia struna, C. Nechajte ju zadunieť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Sit near the front edge of a chair, feet flat and knees apart, as if you could stand up easily. The cello rests between your knees.
rows.translation: Sadnite si blízko predného okraja stoličky, chodidlá naplocho a kolená od seba, akoby ste mohli ľahko vstať. Violončelo spočíva medzi kolenami.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Pull out the endpin until the cello's top edge meets your chest at the breastbone and the C peg sits near your left ear. Tighten the screw. A rest or strap keeps it from sliding.
rows.translation: Bodec vysuňte tak, aby horný okraj violončela siahal na hruď k hrudnej kosti a kolík C bol pri ľavom uchu. Utiahnite skrutku. Podložka alebo popruh zabráni kĺzaniu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Where does the top edge of the cello touch you?
rows.translation: Kde sa vás dotýka horný okraj violončela?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The cello leans back against your chest, and your knees steady it lightly from the sides.
rows.translation: Violončelo sa opiera dozadu o hruď a kolená ho ľahko stabilizujú zboku.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Sitting tall, pluck D, then G. Keep your shoulders loose.
rows.translation: Seďte vzpriamene a brnknite D, potom G. Ramená nechajte uvoľnené.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Bend your thumb and set its tip where the frog meets the stick, across from your middle finger. Drape all four fingers over the stick and let the hand hang heavy.
rows.translation: Palec ohnite a jeho konček položte na spoj žabky a prúta oproti prostredníku. Všetky štyri prsty voľne preložte cez prút a nechajte pôsobiť váhu ruky.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Set the bow on the D string, halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Pull it slowly to the right.
rows.translation: Sláčik položte na strunu D v polovici medzi kobylkou a hmatníkom. Pomaly ťahajte doprava.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Now the A string. Move your whole arm to its level, then pull slowly.
rows.translation: Teraz struna A. Celú ruku presuňte do jej výšky a pomaly ťahajte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Entire open-cello-string pitch sequence C G D A; exact notes and order must be retained. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: From low to high: C, G, D, A. Each string is five letter names above the last, an interval called a fifth. Try: Cats Go Dancing Around.
rows.translation: Od nízkej po vysokú: C, G, D, A. Každá struna je o kvintu vyššie, teda päť názvov tónov pri počítaní od prvého vrátane. Pomôcka: Cirkusová Gorila Dáva Autogramy.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Your right arm sets which string the bow plays. Each string has its own arm level, like the steps of a stair. Move the whole arm, not just the hand.
rows.translation: Pravá ruka určuje, na ktorej strune hrá sláčik. Každá struna má vlastnú výšku ruky ako schody. Pohybujte celou rukou, nielen dlaňou.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Bow the C string, then G. Let your arm settle at each level.
rows.translation: Zahrajte sláčikom strunu C a potom G. V každej výške nechajte ruku usadiť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Orchestras tune to A. Timbre shows how far each string is from its note in cents; 100 cents make a half step, the smallest step on a piano. Tune A, then D, G and C.
rows.translation: Orchestre ladia podľa A. Timbre ukazuje odchýlku struny od jej tónu v centoch; 100 centov tvorí poltón, najmenší krok na klavíri. Nalaďte A, potom D, G a C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Now D, G and C. Tune each one, then bow it and hold it.
rows.translation: Teraz D, G a C. Každú nalaďte, potom zahrajte sláčikom a podržte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Sit tall with the endpin set, soft bow hold, bow halfway between bridge and fingerboard. Now play everything from this unit.
rows.translation: Seďte vzpriamene s nastaveným bodcom, sláčik držte mäkko v polovici medzi kobylkou a hmatníkom. Teraz zahrajte všetko z tejto jednotky.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the D string: open D, first finger a whole step up for E, third finger two whole steps up for F sharp. Pluck it first, then bow it.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb hráte na strune D: prázdne D, prvý prst o celý tón vyššie na E, tretí prst o dva celé tóny nad prázdnym D na Fis. Najprv brnkajte, potom hrajte sláčikom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: First finger on the D string, a whole step up. That's E.
rows.translation: Prvý prst na strune D o celý tón vyššie. To je E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Third finger, a whole step above your first. That's F sharp.
rows.translation: Tretí prst o celý tón nad prvým. To je Fis.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: F sharp, E, D, E, then F sharp three times.
rows.translation: Fis, E, D, E, potom trikrát Fis.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: One slow down-bow, then one slow up-bow on D. Keep the sound even to the end.
rows.translation: Jeden pomalý ťah od žabky, potom jeden k žabke na D. Zvuk držte rovnomerný až do konca.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Štvrťové noty na D a A
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D, A, D, A. Let your arm rock between the two levels.
rows.translation: D, A, D, A. Nechajte ruku kolísať medzi dvoma výškami.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Going from C to D skips the G string, so your arm makes a bigger move. Travel smoothly and don't let the middle string sound.
rows.translation: Pri prechode z C na D preskočíte G, preto ruka urobí väčší pohyb. Prejdite plynulo a prostrednú strunu nerozozvučte.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: One finger per half step: play D major and your first melodies.
rows.translation: Jeden prst na poltón: hrajte D dur a prvé melódie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A half step is the smallest step in music. In first position your fingers sit a half step apart, starting a whole step (two half steps) above the open string. Thumb behind the neck, across from second finger.
rows.translation: Poltón je najmenší krok v hudbe. V prvej polohe sú prsty od seba po poltónoch, pričom prvý začína o celý tón (dva poltóny) nad prázdnou strunou. Palec je za krkom oproti druhému prstu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open D, then E with your first finger. Hold E until it settles in tune.
rows.translation: Prázdne D, potom E prvým prstom. E držte, kým nebude čisté.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Same finger on the A string: open A, then B.
rows.translation: Rovnaký prst na strune A: prázdne A, potom B.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open D, then E. How far apart?
rows.translation: Prázdne D, potom E. Aká je vzdialenosť?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: First finger on D and A
rows.translation: Prvý prst na D a A
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Third finger plays F sharp, a whole step above E. Let second finger hover over its spot between 1 and 3, so your hand keeps its shape.
rows.translation: Tretí prst hrá Fis, o celý tón nad E. Druhý prst nech sa vznáša nad svojím miestom medzi 1 a 3, aby ruka zachovala rozostupy.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D, E, F sharp. Keep first finger down while third plays.
rows.translation: D, E, Fis. Keď hrá tretí prst, prvý nechajte položený.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: From E to the next note: what kind of step?
rows.translation: Aký krok je z E na ďalší tón?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Why does second finger stay over its spot?
rows.translation: Prečo druhý prst zostáva nad svojím miestom?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Each finger owns a half step. Keeping all four in place makes every note land in the same spot each time.
rows.translation: Každému prstu patrí poltón. Keď všetky štyri zostávajú na svojich miestach, každý tón trafíte vždy rovnako.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Same fingers on the A string: open A, B, C sharp.
rows.translation: Rovnaké prsty na strune A: prázdne A, B, Cis.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Fourth finger plays G, a half step above F sharp. D, E, F sharp, G is the first half of the D major scale: open, 1, 3, 4.
rows.translation: Štvrtý prst hrá G, o poltón nad Fis. D, E, Fis, G je prvá polovica D dur: prázdna, 1, 3, 4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D, E, F sharp, G: open, 1, 3, 4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Fourth-finger G on the D string is an octave above the open G string: the same letter, eight notes higher. When it's in tune, the G string hums along.
rows.translation: G štvrtým prstom na strune D je o oktávu nad prázdnou strunou G: rovnaký názov, ôsmy tón pri počítaní od prvého vrátane. Keď je čisté, struna G rezonuje spolu s ním.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Fourth-finger G, open G, then fourth-finger G again. Listen for the ring.
rows.translation: G štvrtým prstom, prázdne G, znova G štvrtým prstom. Počúvajte súzvuk.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Play D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, then A, B, C sharp, D on the A string. The same fingers twice: open, 1, 3, 4.
rows.translation: Na strune D zahrajte D, E, Fis, G, potom na strune A A, B, Cis, D. Dvakrát rovnaké prsty: prázdna, 1, 3, 4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which fingers play D major on each string?
rows.translation: Ktoré prsty hrajú D dur na každej strune?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: This French melody from the 1700s uses only notes you've learned: D, E, F sharp, G on the D string, and A and B on the A string.
rows.translation: Táto francúzska melódia zo storočia začínajúceho rokom 1700 používa iba naučené tóny: D, E, Fis, G na strune D a A aj B na strune A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which finger plays B on the A string?
rows.translation: Ktorým prstom hráte B na strune A?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open, 1, 3, 4 on the D and A strings. Keep the hand's shape, land each note in tune, and let the octaves ring.
rows.translation: Prázdna, 1, 3, 4 na strunách D a A. Zachovajte tvar ruky, každý tón zahrajte čisto a nechajte oktávy znieť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Third finger to fourth: what kind of step?
rows.translation: Od tretieho po štvrtý prst: aký krok?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Two octave checks: G with open G, then fourth-finger D with open D.
rows.translation: Dve oktávové kontroly: G s prázdnym G, potom D štvrtým prstom s prázdnym D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which finger plays C sharp on the A string?
rows.translation: Ktorým prstom hráte Cis na strune A?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Two low strings, C major and G major scales, and three classic melodies.
rows.translation: Dve hlboké struny, stupnice C dur a G dur a tri klasické melódie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: On the G string, first finger plays A, third finger B, and fourth finger C. Same spacing as on D. Let your arm settle at the G string level.
rows.translation: Na strune G hrá prvý prst A, tretí B a štvrtý C. Rovnaké rozostupy ako na D. Ruku nechajte usadiť vo výške struny G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G, A, B, C on the G string plus D, E, F sharp, G on the D string make the G major scale. Same fingers on both strings.
rows.translation: G, A, B, C na strune G spolu s D, E, Fis, G na strune D tvoria stupnicu G dur. Rovnaké prsty na oboch strunách.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which finger plays C on the G string?
rows.translation: Ktorým prstom hráte C na strune G?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: On the C string, first finger plays D, third finger E, and fourth finger F. The thick string needs a slow, heavy bow to speak.
rows.translation: Na strune C hrá prvý prst D, tretí E a štvrtý F. Hrubá struna potrebuje pomalý ťah s váhou ruky, aby sa rozozvučala.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: C, D, E, F: open, 1, 3, 4. Give each note time to speak.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F: prázdna, 1, 3, 4. Každému tónu dajte čas zaznieť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: C, D, E, F on the C string plus G, A, B, C on the G string is the C major scale. It has no sharps at all.
rows.translation: C, D, E, F na strune C spolu s G, A, B, C na strune G tvoria C dur. Nemá žiadne krížiky.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Up the C major scale. At the top, listen for C ringing with the open C string.
rows.translation: Nahor po C dur. Navrchu počúvajte, ako C rezonuje s prázdnou strunou C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Second finger plays F natural on the D string, a half step below F sharp, and C natural on the A string. C major needs both.
rows.translation: Druhý prst hrá F bez posuvky na strune D, o poltón pod Fis, a C bez posuvky na strune A. C dur potrebuje oba tóny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D, E, F, G: open, 1, 2, 4. Second finger sits right next to first.
rows.translation: D, E, F, G: prázdna, 1, 2, 4. Druhý prst je tesne vedľa prvého.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: E, then second finger or third?
rows.translation: E, potom druhý alebo tretí prst?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Cellists give each finger its own half step, so F takes second finger and F sharp takes third. A note just past the hand, like F sharp on the C string, needs an extension, a wider hand. This course picks keys that avoid it.
rows.translation: Violončelisti prideľujú každému prstu poltón, preto F hrá druhý a Fis tretí. Tón tesne za rukou, napríklad Fis na strune C, vyžaduje rozšírenie ruky. Tento kurz volí tóniny, ktoré sa mu vyhýbajú.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: C major, second octave: second finger for F and for the top C.
rows.translation: C dur, druhá oktáva: druhý prst pre F aj vrchné C.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Ode to Joy, an octave up
rows.translation: Óda na radosť o oktávu vyššie
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Brahms wrote this lullaby in 1868. It rocks in three on the G and D strings. Use long, slow bows and let each phrase breathe.
rows.translation: Brahms napísal túto uspávanku v roku 1868. Kolíše sa na tri na strunách G a D. Hrajte dlhými pomalými ťahmi a nechajte každú frázu dýchať.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G, F sharp, E: fingers 4, 3, 1. This is the lullaby's high point.
rows.translation: G, Fis, E: prsty 4, 3, 1. Toto je najvyššie miesto uspávanky.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Proper title identifying the traditional French song; reviewer must assess any established Slovak title, not blanket-retain generic prose. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: Au clair de la lune is a French folk song from the 1700s. It lives on the G and D strings, with C under your fourth finger.
rows.translation: Au clair de la lune je francúzska ľudová pieseň zo storočia začínajúceho rokom 1700. Hrá sa na strunách G a D, s C pod štvrtým prstom.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D, C, B, A, G: open D, then fingers 4, 3, 1 and open G.
rows.translation: D, C, B, A, G: prázdne D, potom prsty 4, 3, 1 a prázdne G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which notes in this tune are open strings?
rows.translation: Ktoré tóny v tejto melódii sú prázdne struny?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open, 1, 3, 4 on every string, with second finger for F and C natural. Slow, heavy bows on the low strings.
rows.translation: Prázdna, 1, 3, 4 na každej strune, s druhým prstom pre F a C bez posuvky. Na hlbokých strunách hrajte pomaly s váhou ruky.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Two octave checks: C with open C, then G with open G.
rows.translation: Dve oktávové kontroly: C s prázdnym C, potom G s prázdnym G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which of these keys has no sharps?
rows.translation: Ktorá z týchto tónin nemá krížiky?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Slide to fourth position, check it by ear, and play The Swan and Amazing Grace.
rows.translation: Prejdite sklzom do štvrtej polohy, overte ju sluchom a zahrajte Labuť aj Amazing Grace.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A shift moves your whole hand to a new place on the string. Lighten the finger, slide it along the string without lifting, and let your thumb travel with the hand.
rows.translation: Pri výmene polohy sa celá ruka presunie na nové miesto na strune. Uvoľnite prst, bez zdvihnutia ho posuňte po strune a palec nech cestuje spolu s rukou.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In fourth position, first finger plays D on the A string, the note fourth finger played in first position. Your thumb settles where the neck curves into the body.
rows.translation: V štvrtej polohe hrá prvý prst D na strune A, teda tón, ktorý v prvej polohe hral štvrtý prst. Palec sa usadí tam, kde krk prechádza do tela.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: B with first finger, then slide that finger up to D. Keep it light on the way.
rows.translation: B prvým prstom, potom tým istým prstom skĺznite nahor na D. Počas pohybu tlačte len ľahko.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: Čo sa pohybuje pri výmene polohy?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Moving the hand as one unit keeps your finger spacing, so the next notes land in tune too.
rows.translation: Pohyb celej ruky ako jednotky zachová rozostupy prstov, takže aj ďalšie tóny budú čisté.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Shift up, back, and up again on first finger. Land each note in tune.
rows.translation: Prvým prstom prejdite nahor, späť a znova nahor. Každý tón trafte čisto.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Complete ordered pitch sequence; no prose. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: In fourth position on the A string, first finger plays D, third finger E, and fourth finger F. Same frame as first position: one finger per half step.
rows.translation: V štvrtej polohe na strune A hrá prvý prst D, tretí E a štvrtý F. Rozloženie je ako v prvej polohe: jeden prst na každý poltón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: D, E, F: fingers 1, 3, 4. Up here the notes sit a little closer together.
rows.translation: D, E, F: prsty 1, 3, 4. Tu vyššie sú tóny o niečo bližšie pri sebe.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open A, B, shift on first finger to D, then E with third.
rows.translation: Prázdna A, B, presuňte prvý prst na D a potom zahrajte E tretím.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In fourth position on the A string, which finger plays E?
rows.translation: Ktorý prst hrá E v štvrtej polohe na strune A?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Up to fourth position and back
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Check it with the open A
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In fourth position on the D string, first finger plays G and third plays A, the same note as the open A string. Play them one after the other and match them.
rows.translation: V štvrtej polohe na strune D hrá prvý prst G a tretí A, rovnaký tón ako prázdna struna A. Zahrajte ich po sebe a zlaďte ich.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: First-finger G, then third-finger A, both on the D string.
rows.translation: G prvým prstom, potom A tretím, oba na strune D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Fourth-position A, open A, fourth-position A. Make them one sound.
rows.translation: A v štvrtej polohe, prázdna A, A v štvrtej polohe. Nech znejú rovnako.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.translation: V ktorej dvojici sú tóny zhodné?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Play E with first finger in first position, then slide that finger up to G. That's three half steps, the same distance as B to D on the A string.
rows.translation: Zahrajte E prvým prstom v prvej polohe a posuňte ho nahor na G. Sú to tri poltóny, rovnaká vzdialenosť ako z B na D na strune A.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: First-finger E, then slide to first-finger G. Let the thumb travel too.
rows.translation: E prvým prstom, potom ho posuňte na G. Nech sa pohybuje aj palec.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
Slovak drafting AI
rows.invariant_candidate_reason: Composer surname and original year credit; no prose. Candidate pending independent review.

rows.source: The Swan comes from The Carnival of the Animals, written by Camille Saint-Saëns in 1886. This is its opening phrase, an octave lower and simplified.
rows.translation: Labuť pochádza z Karnevalu zvierat, ktorý Camille Saint-Saëns napísal v roku 1886. Toto je jej úvodná fráza, zjednodušená a o oktávu nižšie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Long notes need slow bows. Keep the bow close to the bridge and spread it evenly, so each note lasts to its very end without fading.
rows.translation: Dlhé tóny potrebujú pomalý sláčik. Držte ho blízko kobylky a rovnomerne rozdeľte jeho ťah, aby každý tón vydržal až do konca bez slabnutia.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: G, F sharp, B: fourth and third finger on D, then third finger on G.
rows.translation: G, Fis, B: štvrtý a tretí prst na D, potom tretí prst na G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: How do you keep a long note from fading?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In Amazing Grace, the high D comes right after open A. While the A rings, slide your hand up to fourth position and land on D with first finger.
rows.translation: V Amazing Grace príde vysoké D hneď po prázdnej A. Kým A znie, posuňte ruku do štvrtej polohy a položte prvý prst na D.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: B, open A, then first-finger D in fourth position. Move while the A sounds.
rows.translation: B, prázdna A, potom D prvým prstom v štvrtej polohe. Presuňte sa, kým A znie.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: When is the easiest moment to shift?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In the middle of a long note
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: While an open string sounds, your left hand is free, so the shift can't be heard.
rows.translation: Kým znie prázdna struna, ľavá ruka je voľná, takže presun nebude počuť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Lighten the finger, move hand and thumb together, and check where you land. The open strings will tell you if you're right.
rows.translation: Odľahčite prst, posuňte ruku aj palec spolu a skontrolujte cieľový tón. Prázdne struny vám prezradia, či hráte čisto.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Fourth-position A on the D string, then open A. Match them.
rows.translation: A v štvrtej polohe na strune D, potom prázdna A. Zlaďte ich.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: In fourth position, which note does first finger play on the A string?
rows.translation: Ktorý tón hrá prvý prst na strune A v štvrtej polohe?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: From paired strings to fiddle tunes and the bluegrass chop
rows.translation: Od zdvojených strún po husľové melódie a bluegrassový chop
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Meet the paired strings, tune them and play all four open notes.
rows.translation: Spoznajte zdvojené struny, nalaďte ich a zahrajte všetky štyri prázdne tóny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A mandolin has eight strings in four pairs, called courses. The two strings of a pair are tuned to the same note and played together, so you treat each pair as one string.
rows.translation: Mandolína má osem strún v štyroch dvojiciach, takzvaných zboroch. Obe struny dvojice sú naladené na rovnaký tón a hrajú sa spolu, takže každú dvojicu vnímate ako jednu strunu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The pair nearest your face is the lowest, pair 4. The pair nearest the floor is the highest, pair 1. When a lesson says string 3, it means the third pair.
rows.translation: Dvojica najbližšie k tvári znie najnižšie a má číslo 4. Tá najbližšie k podlahe znie najvyššie a má číslo 1. Keď lekcia hovorí o strune 3, myslí tým tretiu dvojicu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: How do you play a pair?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Both strings at once, as one note
rows.translation: Obe struny naraz ako jeden tón
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: The two strings sit close together, so one pick stroke catches both. Together they ring as one fuller note.
rows.translation: Obe struny sú blízko pri sebe, takže ich zasiahne jeden úder brnkadla. Spolu znejú ako jeden plnší tón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Pick the lowest pair, pair 4, and let it ring.
rows.translation: Brnknite na najnižšiu dvojicu, číslo 4, a nechajte ju znieť.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Each pair has to match the tuner and match itself. If its two strings disagree, you hear a slow wobble. Tune one string, then bring its partner to the same note.
rows.translation: Každá dvojica musí ladiť s ladičkou aj sama so sebou. Ak sa jej struny nezhodujú, počujete pomalé kolísanie. Nalaďte jednu a potom druhú na rovnaký tón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Pair 3, the D pair. Tune both strings until the wobble stops.
rows.translation: Dvojica 3, dvojica D. Nalaďte obe struny, kým kolísanie neprestane.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: One pair has a slow wobble. What is wrong?
rows.translation: Jedna dvojica pomaly kolíše. Čo je zle?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: That wobble is called beating: the two strings are slightly apart. Tune them until it smooths out.
rows.translation: Toto kolísanie sa nazýva rázy: struny sa výškou mierne líšia. Laďte ich, kým sa zvuk neustáli.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Loosen a little below the note, then tighten up to it. Approaching from below keeps the string from slipping flat later.
rows.translation: Povoľte strunu trochu pod cieľový tón a potom ju k nemu dotiahnite. Ladenie zdola bráni neskoršiemu skĺznutiu pod správnu výšku.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Pair 4, then pair 1. Bring each string up to the note from below.
rows.translation: Dvojica 4, potom dvojica 1. Každú strunu dolaďte k cieľovému tónu zdola.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Hold the pick between the pad of your thumb and the side of your curled index finger. Let only the tip show. Keep your wrist loose, as if shaking water off your hand.
rows.translation: Brnkadlo držte medzi bruškom palca a bokom ohnutého ukazováka. Nech vyčnieva len špička. Zápästie uvoľnite, akoby ste z ruky striasali vodu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: How much of the pick should show?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A short tip gives you control and a clean sound. Too much pick snags on the paired strings.
rows.translation: Krátka špička dáva kontrolu a čistý zvuk. Priveľká vyčnievajúca časť sa zachytáva o zdvojené struny.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Push the pick down through both strings of a pair in one small motion and stop just past them. Rest the heel of your hand lightly near the bridge.
rows.translation: Malým pohybom pretlačte brnkadlo nadol cez obe struny dvojice a zastavte hneď za nimi. Spodnú časť dlane zľahka oprite pri kobylke.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: From low to high, the pairs are G, D, A and E. Try: Good Dogs Always Eat. A violin is tuned the same way, so fiddle tunes sit naturally on a mandolin.
rows.translation: Od najnižšej po najvyššiu sú dvojice G, D, A a E. Skúste: Gorila dnes asi experimentuje. Husle sú naladené rovnako, preto sa husľové melódie na mandolíne hrajú prirodzene.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Low to high: G, D, A, E.
rows.translation: Od najnižšej: G, D, A, E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Now high to low: E, A, D, G.
rows.translation: Teraz od najvyššej: E, A, D, G.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Tuned pairs, a relaxed pick and four open notes. Play each one cleanly, with both strings of the pair ringing.
rows.translation: Naladené dvojice, uvoľnené brnkadlo a štyri prázdne tóny. Zahrajte každý čisto, aby zneli obe struny dvojice.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Which pair is the highest in pitch?
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Pairs count from the highest, pair 1, to the lowest, pair 4.
rows.translation: Dvojice sa číslujú od najvyššej, dvojice 1, po najnižšiu, dvojicu 4.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: A, G, E, D. Find each pair by its name.
rows.translation: A, G, E, D. Nájdite každú dvojicu podľa názvu.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Mary Had a Little Lamb lives on the D pair: open D, E at fret 2 with your first finger, and F sharp at fret 4 with your second.
rows.translation: Mary Had a Little Lamb zahráte na dvojici D: prázdne D, E na pražci 2 prvým prstom a Fis na pražci 4 druhým.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Pair 3, fret 2, first finger. That's E.
rows.translation: Dvojica 3, pražec 2, prvý prst. To je E.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Pair 3, fret 4, second finger. That's F sharp.
rows.translation: Dvojica 3, pražec 4, druhý prst. To je Fis.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Fret notes cleanly, learn two frets per finger and play the D major scale.
rows.translation: Stláčajte tóny čisto, osvojte si dva pražce na prst a zahrajte stupnicu D dur.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Press both strings of a pair with one fingertip, just behind the metal fret. Mandolin strings are tight, so use the very tip and press only as hard as a clean note needs.
rows.translation: Jednou špičkou prsta stlačte obe struny dvojice tesne za kovovým pražcom. Struny mandolíny sú napnuté: použite samú špičku a tlačte len toľko, koľko treba na čistý tón.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Right behind the fret takes the least pressure and gives the cleanest note.
rows.translation: Tesne za pražcom stačí najmenší tlak a tón je najčistejší.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI

rows.source: Open, fret 2, fret 4: D, E, F♯.
rows.translation: Prázdna struna, pražec 2, pražec 4: D, E, F♯.
rows.author: Slovak drafting AI
